title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
title_zh: TCSExam：在前沿大语言模型上评估 TCS 研究的完整范围

paragraphs.en: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving , solver engineering , and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures , capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. The TCSExam Index combines all four tracks: GPT-6 Astra leads Full (71.9), and Opus 5.5 leads Lite (72.3). Full and Lite rankings are strongly aligned across eight shared agents (Spearman’s ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 ), supporting Lite as a compact, discriminative benchmark. The evaluations yield improved solver outputs and mathematical constructions, together with independently verified special cases and bounds from open-conjecture attempts. TCSExam provides an extensible framework with task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools for reproducible use.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能否推进理论计算机科学的发展，并解决其长期悬而未决的猜想？ 为了研究朝这一目标取得的进展，我们提出 TCSExam，这是一个覆盖理论计算机科学（TCS）全部研究范围的统一框架与基准。 它评估定理证明、求解器工程与构造，同时涵盖解决开放猜想的直接尝试，既捕捉具体的研究成果，也反映朝长期研究目标所取得的进展。 TCSExam-Full 包含 100 个经专家审阅的任务，提交结果由 Lean 内核或可执行任务检查器进行校验。 TCSExam-Lite 精选出 20 个任务，每个赛道 5 个，在单次尝试预算相同的情况下，将任务尝试次数减少 80%。 我们在 Full 上评估了 8 个智能体，在 Lite 上评估了 9 个智能体。 TCSExam 指数综合了全部四个赛道：GPT-6 Astra 在 Full 上领先（71.9），Opus 5.5 在 Lite 上领先（72.3）。 在 8 个共同评估的智能体上，Full 与 Lite 的排名高度一致（Spearman ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93），支持 Lite 作为一个紧凑且具有区分度的基准。 评估带来了改进的求解器输出与数学构造，以及来自开放猜想尝试的、经独立验证的特殊情形和界。 TCSExam 提供了一个可扩展的框架，包含任务来源、Docker 构建配方与评估工具，以便可复现地使用。

paragraphs.en: Can large language models (LLMs) resolve long-standing open conjectures and advance theoretical computer science? Studying progress toward this ambition poses a challenge for evaluation: when a conjecture remains unresolved, the final outcome alone reveals little about which research tasks an LLM can perform or where its limitations lie. An informative evaluation should therefore examine concrete research accomplishments alongside direct attempts to prove or refute open conjectures.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）能否解决长期悬而未决的公开猜想，并推动理论计算机科学的发展？ 研究朝这一目标所取得的进展给评估带来了挑战：当一个猜想尚未解决时，仅凭最终结果几乎无法揭示大语言模型能够完成哪些研究任务，或其局限在哪里。 因此，有信息量的评估应当在考察直接尝试证明或反驳公开猜想的同时，考察具体的研究成果。

paragraphs.en: Three forms of research output provide concrete ways to examine these questions. Theorem proving requires complete arguments for research-level mathematical statements. Solver engineering produces reusable programs whose effectiveness is tested across problem instances. Constructions provide explicit mathematical objects with verified properties that establish or improve bounds. Each output has independent research value, and the methods used to obtain them can interact: solvers search for candidate objects, proofs establish their properties, and constructions can supply witnesses or counterexamples. Evaluating these outputs helps TCS researchers judge which research work LLMs can undertake and helps model developers identify priorities for improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 三种形式的研究产出为考察这些问题提供了具体的途径。 定理证明需要对研究水平的数学命题给出完整的论证。 求解器工程产出可复用的程序，其有效性在多个问题实例上进行检验。 构造提供具有经过验证性质的显式数学对象，用以确立或改进界。 每种产出都具有独立的研究价值，而获得它们的方法可以相互作用：求解器搜索候选对象，证明确立其性质，构造则可以提供见证或反例。 评估这些产出有助于理论计算机科学（TCS）研究者判断大语言模型（LLM）能够承担哪些研究工作，也有助于模型开发者确定改进的优先事项。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks address selected aspects of TCS research (Table 1 ). We introduce TCSExam , a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research (Figure 1 ). Its four tracks evaluate theorem proving, solver engineering, constructions, and open-conjecture settlement, with success criteria defined by the requested outputs. Research areas can span multiple tracks, and shared task interfaces and verification protocols support the incorporation of additional problems.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准只涵盖理论计算机科学（TCS）研究的部分方面（表 1）。 我们提出 TCSExam，一个覆盖理论计算机科学研究全范围统一框架与基准（图 1）。 其四条赛道分别评估定理证明、求解器工程、构造以及开放猜想解决，成功标准由所要求的输出定义。 研究领域可跨越多条赛道，共享的任务接口与验证协议支持纳入更多问题。

paragraphs.en: TCSExam comprises 100 tasks: 20 research theorems to prove in Lean 4 ( de Moura & Ullrich, 2021 ) , 30 solver-engineering problems evaluated over instance families, 20 construction problems scored against documented records, and 30 open conjectures in prove-or-refute form. Authors with expertise in the relevant TCS areas reviewed all 100 tasks for research significance. Every submission is checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. This combines expert judgment about which problems matter with reproducible verification of the submitted results. For smaller-scale evaluations, TCSExam-Lite provides a 20-task subset with five tasks per track, selected to cover diverse topics and performance profiles within the Full suite.
paragraphs.zh: TCSExam 包含 100 个任务：20 个需在 Lean 4（de Moura & Ullrich, 2021）中证明的研究定理，30 个在实例族上评估的求解器工程问题，20 个对照已记录纪录评分的构造问题，以及 30 个以证明或反驳形式给出的公开猜想。 具有相关 TCS 领域专业知识的作者对全部 100 个任务的研究意义进行了评审。 每个提交都由 Lean 内核或可执行的任务检查器进行验证。 这将关于哪些问题重要的专家判断与所提交结果的可复现验证结合起来。 对于较小规模的评估，TCSExam-Lite 提供了一个包含 20 个任务、每条赛道五个任务的子集，其选取旨在覆盖完整套件中的多样化主题与性能特征。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. On 20 research theorems without supplied intermediate lemmas, GPT-6 Astra achieves a per-attempt complete-proof success rate of 70.0%, followed by Kimi K3.1 Pro at 38.3%; the other six agents achieve at most 11.7%. Solver performance varies across instance families, with submitted programs improving on public competition circuits. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 produces a verified construction that exceeds a task reference despite completing none of its 60 theorem-proving attempts. Individual attempts also yield independently verified special cases and bounds (Section 5.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Full 上评估八个智能体，在 Lite 上评估九个智能体。 在 20 个未提供中间引理的研究定理上，GPT-6 Astra 的单次尝试完整证明成功率达到 70.0%，Kimi K3.1 Pro 以 38.3% 位居第二；其余六个智能体的成功率最高仅为 11.7%。 求解器性能因实例族而异，其中提交的程序在公开竞赛电路上有所改进。 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 尽管在 60 次定理证明尝试中无一完成，却产生了一个超出任务参考答案的、经验证的构造。 单次尝试还产生了经过独立验证的特殊情形和界（第 5.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: Theorem proving in mathematics and TCS. TCS-BENCH ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) evaluates research-level natural-language proofs using an LLM verifier. Despite reported accuracy above 90% against expert judgments, acceptance remains subject to verifier errors and provides no formal correctness guarantee. FormalTCS ( Wang et al., 2026 ) evaluates end-to-end formalization and proving of TCS results. Their benchmark scope does not include reusable solver performance or construction quality. Formal evaluation also spans competition mathematics, undergraduate mathematics, and repository-context proofs ( Zheng et al., 2021 ; Tsoukalas et al., 2024 ; Azerbayev et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2024 ) . CombiBench provides formal combinatorial problems in Lean 4 ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , while LeanGeo-Bench evaluates competition geometry in the LeanGeo framework ( Song et al., 2025 ) . Kimina-Prover uses reinforcement learning to train structured reasoning for Lean 4 proof generation ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Proof guidance and decomposition are studied by Draft, Sketch, and Prove, DeepSeek-Prover-V2, and Seed-Prover ( Jiang et al., 2022 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Theorem proving (20 tasks). Given a formal statement derived from a research theorem, the model submits a Lean 4 proof. We vary the supplied context through three settings with a common target: bare provides the main statement, fixed definitions, and mathematical assumptions; ladder additionally provides intermediate lemma statements; guided further supplies proof ideas. This design is related to TCS-BENCH’s use of intermediate-result masking to vary proof-task difficulty ( Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ) . Our main evaluation uses bare to measure complete-proof success. Ladder and guided support a separate analysis of proof guidance, with partial checkpoint credit and independent complete-proof checks (Section 3.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 定理证明（20 个任务）。 给定一个由研究定理导出的形式化陈述，模型提交一个 Lean 4 证明。 我们通过三个具有共同目标的设置来变化所提供的上下文：bare 提供主要陈述、固定定义和数学假设；ladder 额外提供中间引理陈述；guided 进一步提供证明思路。 该设计与 TCS-BENCH 使用中间结果掩码来改变证明任务难度的做法相关（ Cohen-Addad et al., 2026 ） 。 我们的主要评估使用 bare 来衡量完整证明的成功率。 Ladder 和 guided 支持对证明引导的单独分析，包括部分检查点得分和独立的完整证明检验（第 3.3 节 ）。

paragraphs.en: Solver engineering (30 tasks). The model receives a problem specification, a naive baseline, and public instances, then submits a reusable solver program. Final judging evaluates the program across the task’s designated instance set under task-specific resource limits. Checkers validate solutions or certificates and recompute objective values.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器工程（30个任务）。 模型接收问题规范、一个朴素的基线解法和公开实例，然后提交一个可复用的求解器程序。 最终评判在任务特定的资源限制下，跨任务的指定实例集评估该程序。 校验器验证解或证书，并重新计算目标值。

paragraphs.en: Constructions (20 tasks). The model submits an explicit mathematical object and a certificate of its required properties. Examples include codes, geometric configurations, and graph colorings. Tasks use Lean 4 formalizations and executable checks to verify the object and its achieved parameter. Documented construction records provide reference values against which progress is measured; the model may use mathematical reasoning, search code, or both to produce its submission.
paragraphs.zh: 构造题（20 个任务）。 模型需提交一个明确的数学对象及其所需性质的证明证书。 例子包括编码、几何构形和图染色。 任务使用 Lean 4 形式化和可执行检查来验证该对象及其达到的参数。 已记录的构造记录提供了用于衡量进展的参考值；模型可以运用数学推理、搜索代码，或两者结合来产生其提交内容。

paragraphs.en: Open conjectures (30 tasks). The model receives a formalized conjecture and two Lean proof slots, conj and refuted , for the statement and its negation. A submission must prove either side in full. A counterexample must come with a proof that it refutes the stated conjecture. This interface accepts either direction of a resolution.

paragraphs.en: We select tasks for their research significance , coverage across TCS areas , and verifiable outcomes . Theorem tasks come from recent TCS papers (2023–2026) and span 13 subfields. Solver tasks draw on established competitions and instance libraries. Task-specific safeguards, including withholding hidden instances from the agent during development and applying structure-preserving transformations, mitigate direct reuse of stored answers. Construction tasks target open problems with documented records, while the open-conjecture track includes problems such as log-rank and Ryser. Expert review assesses the significance and representativeness of the selected problems.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据研究意义、对理论计算机科学（TCS）各领域的覆盖范围以及可验证的结果来选择任务。 定理类任务来自近年的理论计算机科学论文（2023–2026年），并涵盖13个子领域。 求解类任务取材于成熟的竞赛与实例库。 任务专属的防护措施——包括在开发阶段对智能体隐藏隐藏实例，以及应用保持结构的变换——可减轻对已存储答案的直接复用。 构造类任务针对有公开记录的开放问题，而开放猜想赛道则包括诸如对数秩（log-rank）与Ryser等问题。 专家评审评估所选问题的重要性与代表性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 summarizes the task development process. An authoring agent prepares the statement, submission interface, scorer, and environment. A separate review agent checks correspondence to the research source and the behavior of the verification procedure. Tests and pilot evaluations identify defects and guide revision. Across development rounds, over 40 theorem problems were retired after being solved in pilot evaluations. Tasks are included after expert approval.

paragraphs.en: Scores reflect the submitted output and the task’s notion of success. Complete proof obligations use binary scores; optimization and construction tasks provide graded credit. The score definitions and integrity checks are specified per track (Appendix B ). Reported scores use percentages rounded to one decimal; formulas use the original score units.

paragraphs.en: Theorem proving. A valid proof of the complete bare-level statement scores 100.0%; an incomplete proof scores 0.0%. Guided and ladder tasks receive partial credit for the fraction of checkpoints passed; a verified complete proof receives full credit. Each checkpoint is checked in isolation with the other checkpoint statements supplied as assumptions; this also applies to the main-theorem checkpoint. Coverage therefore measures conditional proof obligations. Complete proofs are checked separately without unproved checkpoint assumptions (Appendix B.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 定理证明。 完整裸层命题的有效证明得 100.0%；不完整的证明得 0.0%。 引导任务和阶梯任务按通过的检查点比例获得部分分数；经验证的完整证明获得满分。 每个检查点都单独检查，其他检查点命题作为假设提供；这也适用于主定理检查点。 因此，覆盖率衡量的是条件性证明义务。 完整证明会单独检查，不使用未经证明的检查点假设（附录 B.1）。

paragraphs.en: Solver engineering. Optimization tasks measure the fraction of the difference between a naive baseline B B and a task reference K K recovered by the submitted solver. These scores are not clipped: values below 0.0% indicate performance worse than the baseline, and values above 100.0% indicate improvement over the reference. Decision tasks use solve rates. A separate Kimi K3-relative score standardizes raw instance outcomes against repeated Kimi K3 runs and applies a Gaussian cumulative-distribution transform (Appendix B.2 ). Scores are averaged over instances, then attempts within tasks, then tasks. Improvements over K K undergo artifact and source verification before being described as new records.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器工程。 优化任务衡量所提交的求解器在朴素基线 B B 与任务参考 K K 之间所恢复的差异比例。 这些分数不做截断：低于 0.0% 的值表示性能劣于基线，高于 100.0% 的值表示优于参考。 决策任务使用解题率。 一个独立的 Kimi K3 相对分数将原始实例结果与多次 Kimi K3 运行进行标准化对比，并施加高斯累积分布变换（附录 B.2）。 分数先在实例上取平均，再在任务内的各次尝试上取平均，最后在任务上取平均。 相对于 K K 的改进需经过工件与源码验证后，才会被描述为新的纪录。

paragraphs.en: Constructions. Scores measure attainment relative to a trivial construction and a documented record: matching the record scores 100.0%, and surpassing it can score above 100.0%. Task-specific shaping is cubic for 14 tasks and linear for the remainder. We report the achieved mathematical parameters alongside these scores, since the score transformation changes the numerical size of an improvement. A record provides a comparison point even when the optimum remains unknown.
paragraphs.zh: 构造。 分数衡量相对于一个平凡构造和一份已记录纪录的达成程度：与纪录持平得 100.0%，超过纪录可得高于 100.0% 的分数。 针对任务的整形在 14 个任务上为三次形式，其余为线性形式。 我们在给出这些分数的同时报告实际达到的数学参数，因为分数变换会改变改进量的数值大小。 即使最优值仍未知，纪录也提供了一个比较基准。

paragraphs.en: Lite contains five tasks per track, selected from Full. 1 1 1 The task list was fixed before evaluating Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Selection considered subject coverage, difficulty, execution cost, and the performance profiles of the original six agents. The theorem subset spans additive combinatorics, games, coding theory, circuit complexity, and quantum cryptography. Solver tasks cover packing, scheduling, graph optimization, resource assignment, and certified Boolean reasoning. The construction and open-conjecture subsets likewise cover several mathematical objects and research areas (Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: Lite 在每个赛道包含五个任务，均从 Full 中选出。1 1 1 任务列表在评估 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 之前已固定。 选取时考虑了学科覆盖面、难度、执行成本以及最初六个智能体的性能表现。 定理子集涵盖加性组合学、博弈、编码理论、电路复杂度和量子密码学。 求解器任务涵盖装箱、调度、图优化、资源分配和可认证的布尔推理。 构造与开放猜想子集同样涵盖多个数学对象和研究领域（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: Every selected task retains its original scoring function, and the five task means receive equal weight within each track. Lite uses the same 12-hour development budget per attempt: one attempt on each task has a maximum development allocation of 240 hours, compared with 1,200 hours for Full. Task execution can run in parallel, and final judging has its own resource budget. Both Solver protocols use public instances for development. Full provides a parallel self-test service; Lite runs self-tests in the development environment, simplifying deployment. Both use the same final judging rules. Section 4 details these protocols. Section 5.3 compares the observed rankings under the two suite protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 每个被选中的任务都保留其原始评分函数，并且每个赛道内的五个任务均值被赋予相同的权重。 Lite 每次尝试使用相同的 12 小时开发预算：每个任务有一次尝试的最大开发配额为 240 小时，相比之下 Full 为 1,200 小时。 任务执行可以并行运行，最终评审有其自己的资源预算。 两种 Solver 协议都使用公开实例进行开发。 Full 提供并行的自测服务；Lite 在开发环境中运行自测，从而简化部署。 两者使用相同的最终评审规则。 第 4 节详细介绍了这些协议。 第 5.3 节比较了两种套件协议下观察到的排名。

paragraphs.en: Before a task enters the benchmark, task validation checks whether the encoded problem matches its research source. After submission, result validation checks outputs against the task rules, with additional review for candidate advances. Appendix C documents these checks and supporting evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务进入基准之前，任务验证会检查所编码的问题是否与其研究来源相符。 提交之后，结果验证会根据任务规则检查输出，并对候选进展进行额外审查。 附录 C 记录了这些检查及相关支持证据。

sents.zh: 在任务进入基准之前，任务验证会检查所编码的问题是否与其研究来源相符。

sents.zh: 提交之后，结果验证会根据任务规则检查输出，并对候选进展进行额外审查。

sents.zh: 附录 C 记录了这些检查及相关支持证据。

paragraphs.en: Formal statement fidelity. Agent-assisted reviews compare definitions, assumptions, quantifiers, and parameter ranges in the Lean statement with the source. Small examples and boundary cases test for degenerate or unintended interpretations, and re-translation provides an additional cross-check. Shared definitions and statements are checked across disclosure levels. Successful proofs and unexpected outcomes prompt renewed scrutiny of the statement and its assumptions. These checks also flagged potential inconsistencies in source statements or proofs; candidate tasks with unresolved concerns were excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化陈述的忠实性。 智能体辅助的审校将 Lean 陈述中的定义、假设、量词和参数范围与原始文献进行比对。 小型示例和边界情形用于检验是否存在退化或非预期的解释，而重新翻译则提供了额外的交叉验证。 共享的定义和陈述会在不同披露层级之间进行核对。 成功的证明和意外的结果都会促使对陈述及其假设进行重新审视。 这些检查还标记出了源陈述或证明中潜在的不一致之处；存在未解决疑虑的候选任务被排除在外。

sents.en: Formal statement fidelity.
sents.zh: 形式化陈述的忠实性。

sents.en: Agent-assisted reviews compare definitions, assumptions, quantifiers, and parameter ranges in the Lean statement with the source.
sents.zh: 智能体辅助的审校将 Lean 陈述中的定义、假设、量词和参数范围与原始文献进行比对。

sents.zh: 共享的定义和陈述会在不同披露层级之间进行核对。

sents.en: Successful proofs and unexpected outcomes prompt renewed scrutiny of the statement and its assumptions.
sents.zh: 成功的证明和意外的结果都会促使对陈述及其假设进行重新审视。

sents.en: These checks also flagged potential inconsistencies in source statements or proofs; candidate tasks with unresolved concerns were excluded.
sents.zh: 这些检查还标记出了源陈述或证明中潜在的不一致之处；存在未解决疑虑的候选任务被排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Result validation. Every submission is checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. Candidate advances additionally undergo agent-assisted audits of the rollouts and submitted artifacts. These audits check compliance with task rules, proof dependencies or object validity, and the conditions of the claimed improvement. For solver results, this includes comparing instance sets and execution budgets. Source checks distinguish improvements over task references from new literature records; claims of new records require evidence for the prior best value and a matching problem setting.
paragraphs.zh: 结果验证。 每份提交都会由 Lean 内核或可执行的任务检查器进行校验。 晋级的候选提交还会接受由智能体辅助的审计，针对其展开过程与提交产物进行检查。 这些审计会检查任务规则的遵守情况、证明依赖或对象的有效性，以及所声称改进的条件。 对于求解器结果，这包括比较实例集合与执行预算。 来源检查会区分相对任务参考的改进与新的文献纪录；声称新纪录需要提供此前最优值的证据，以及匹配的问题设置。

sents.en: Result validation.
sents.zh: 结果验证。

sents.en: Every submission is checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker.
sents.zh: 每份提交都会由 Lean 内核或可执行的任务检查器进行校验。

sents.en: Candidate advances additionally undergo agent-assisted audits of the rollouts and submitted artifacts.
sents.zh: 晋级的候选提交还会接受由智能体辅助的审计，针对其展开过程与提交产物进行检查。

sents.en: These audits check compliance with task rules, proof dependencies or object validity, and the conditions of the claimed improvement.
sents.zh: 这些审计会检查任务规则的遵守情况、证明依赖或对象的有效性，以及所声称改进的条件。

sents.en: For solver results, this includes comparing instance sets and execution budgets.
sents.zh: 对于求解器结果，这包括比较实例集合与执行预算。

sents.en: Source checks distinguish improvements over task references from new literature records; claims of new records require evidence for the prior best value and a matching problem setting.
sents.zh: 来源检查会区分相对任务参考的改进与新的文献纪录；声称新纪录需要提供此前最优值的证据，以及匹配的问题设置。

paragraphs.en: Task versions and extensions. Each reported result is associated with the task statement, environment, verifier, and reference values used in evaluation. Corrections and additional problems enter new task versions, with changes and affected results recorded. Earlier versions and evaluation records are retained so that results remain interpretable as the benchmark expands.
paragraphs.zh: 任务版本与扩展。 每个报告的结果都与其评估中使用的任务陈述、环境、验证器和参考值相关联。 修正和新增问题会进入新的任务版本，并记录变更及受影响的结果。 早期版本和评估记录会被保留，以便在基准扩展时结果仍可被解释。

paragraphs.en: Tasks and resources. Full contains 20 bare-level theorems, 30 Solver problems, 20 constructions, and 30 open conjectures; Lite contains five tasks per track. Kimi K3, Kimi K3.1 Pro, and both DeepSeek versions contribute three attempts per task; the other agents contribute one. An attempt is one agent run on one task, with a 12-hour wall-clock development budget. Theorem and Solver development have no general Internet access. Construction and open-conjecture tasks permit literature access. Tasks use the Harbor format ( Harbor Framework Team, 2026 ) to package environments, submission interfaces, and verifiers. Construction prompts provide published reference bounds. Solver judging uses separate per-instance or shared-pool budgets (Appendix D.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Solver development protocols. Both protocols provide the same public instances and self-test information during development. Full uses Online: an external service evaluates submitted solvers, parallelizing independent instances to accelerate iteration. Lite uses Offline: agents run public self-tests in their development environment, with parallelism limited by its resources. This removes the need to deploy a parallel judging service. Both protocols reserve hidden-set judging for the final submission and retain the same input split, checker, final execution limits, and fixed Kimi K3 reference. Online and Offline describe how public self-tests run; task network policies are unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器开发协议。 两种协议在开发期间提供相同的公开实例和自测信息。 Full 采用 Online 模式：由外部服务评估提交的求解器，并行处理相互独立的实例以加速迭代。 Lite 采用 Offline 模式：智能体在其开发环境中运行公开自测，并行度受其自身资源的限制。 这就免去了部署并行评审服务的需要。 两种协议都将隐藏集评审保留给最终提交，并保留相同的输入划分、检查器、最终执行限制以及固定的 Kimi K3 参考实现。 Online 和 Offline 描述的是公开自测的运行方式；任务的网络策略保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Score aggregation and shared tasks. We first average attempts within each task, then average tasks equally within a track. Theorem success rates divide complete proofs by all scheduled attempts: 20 or 60 on Full, and 5 or 15 on Lite. The Index combines the four track means using Equation 1 . The 15 non-Solver tasks shared by Full and Lite reuse the same submissions for each of the eight common agents. Solver results come from separate evaluations under each suite’s development protocol. Opus contributes 20 Lite results. Appendix H.2 describes these result sets.

paragraphs.en: Proof-guidance comparison. We compare Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 on the same 20 theorems, with three attempts per theorem in each setting. Bare supplies the target statement and definitions; ladder adds intermediate lemma statements; guided also supplies proof ideas. Complete-proof success requires a verified assembled or direct proof without unproved checkpoint assumptions. We report success per attempt and the number of theorems solved at least once; ladder and guided also receive partial checkpoint credit (Appendix D.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Research proofs distinguish the evaluated agents. GPT-6 Astra completes 14 of 20 theorems (70.0%) without supplied intermediate lemmas. Kimi K3.1 Pro succeeds in 23 of 60 attempts (38.3%), solving nine distinct theorems. It completes all three attempts on the PCP alphabet-soundness task, which Astra does not solve. Kimi K3 succeeds in 7 of 60 attempts (11.7%), covering three theorems. GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max (0902), and Grok 4.6 each succeed in 1 of 20 attempts (5.0%); DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 succeeds in none of 60, while DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 succeeds in 4 of 60 attempts (6.7%) across three theorems. Across the eight agents, four theorems remain unproved.
paragraphs.zh: 研究性证明的完成情况区分了被评测的各智能体。 GPT-6 Astra 在未提供中间引理的情况下完成了 20 条定理中的 14 条（70.0%）。 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在 60 次尝试中成功 23 次（38.3%），解决了九条不同的定理。 它完成了 PCP 字母表可靠性任务的全部三次尝试，而 Astra 未能解决该任务。 Kimi K3 在 60 次尝试中成功 7 次（11.7%），覆盖三条定理。 GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 和 Grok 4.6 各自在 20 次尝试中成功 1 次（5.0%）；DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 在 60 次中无一成功，而 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 在 60 次尝试中成功 4 次（6.7%），涉及三条定理。 在全部八个智能体中，仍有四条定理未被证明。

paragraphs.en: Construction means reflect reference attainment across tasks. Astra has the highest mean at 104.9%, matching the reference on 17 tasks and exceeding it on three. The other agents range from 86.2% to 98.6%, with Kimi K3.1 Pro second. GLM-5.3 averages 97.7% without exceeding any reference, illustrating that broad reference attainment and individual improvements are distinct aspects of performance. Section 5.5 examines the verified improvements on specific tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 构建手段反映了跨任务的参考达成情况。 Astra 的均值最高，为 104.9%，在 17 个任务上与参考持平，在 3 个任务上超过参考。 其他智能体的范围从 86.2% 到 98.6%，其中 Kimi K3.1 Pro 排名第二。 GLM-5.3 平均达到 97.7%，但未在任何任务上超过参考，这说明广泛的参考达成与个别改进是性能的不同侧面。 第 5.5 节考察了在具体任务上经核实的改进。

paragraphs.en: Performance differs across problem families. On each instance, a relative score of 50.0% denotes a valid outcome equal to the Kimi K3 reference mean. Astra averages 64.7%, followed by Kimi K3.1 Pro at 54.1% and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 at 53.1%. The other five agents range from 43.8% to 49.2% (Table 2 ). Astra has the highest unrounded task mean, including ties, on 27 of 30 problems (Figure 3 b). It trails GLM-5.3 on hitting set, Kimi K3 on dominating set, and GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max (0902), Kimi K3.1 Pro, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 marginally on crossing minimization. Appendix E.2 gives detailed results.
paragraphs.zh: 性能因问题族而异。 在每个实例上，相对得分 50.0% 表示与 Kimi K3 参考均值相等的有效结果。 Astra 平均为 64.7%，其次是 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 54.1% 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 的 53.1%。 其余五个智能体的得分在 43.8% 到 49.2% 之间（表 2）。 在 30 个问题中的 27 个上，Astra 拥有最高的未取整任务均值（包括并列）（图 3b）。 它在 hitting set 上落后于 GLM-5.3，在 dominating set 上落后于 Kimi K3，并在 crossing minimization 上略微落后于 GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 Max (0902)、Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017。 附录 E.2 给出了详细结果。

sents.en: Performance differs across problem families.
sents.zh: 性能因问题族而异。

paragraphs.en: Relative scoring limits baseline–reference scaling effects. The original score ( B − A ) / ( B − K ) (B-A)/(B-K) compares objective A A with baseline B B and reference K K . A large | B − K | |B-K| compresses score differences near K K ; a small denominator can amplify individual contributions. We introduce a Kimi K3-relative metric that compares raw outcomes with repeated Kimi K3 results, retains sensitivity near their mean, and bounds contributions to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] on the reported scale. For example, Qwen3.8 Max (0902)'s valid IWLS 2023 circuit for ex37 uses 273,020 AND gates, versus baseline 698 and reference 106. The ratio ( 698 − 273,020 ) / ( 698 − 106 ) ≈ − 460 (698-273{,}020)/(698-106)\approx-460 allows this single oversized circuit to depress the original mean. Qwen3.8 Max (0902) averages 64.7% on that scale and 49.2% on the bounded relative scale. Appendix B.2 defines the metric; Appendix E.2 gives raw outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 相对评分限制了基线–参考缩放带来的影响。 原始分数 (B−A)/(B−K) 将目标 A 与基线 B 和参考 K 进行比较。 较大的 |B−K| 会压缩 K 附近的分数差异；较小的分母则可能放大个别贡献。 我们引入了一种 Kimi K3 相对指标，该指标将原始结果与重复的 Kimi K3 结果进行比较，在其均值附近保持敏感性，并将贡献限制在报告量纲的 [0,100] 区间内。 例如，Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 针对 ex37 的有效 IWLS 2023 电路使用了 273,020 个与门，而基线为 698，参考为 106。 比值 (698−273,020)/(698−106)≈−460 使得这个单个过大的电路能够拉低原始均值。 Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 在该量纲上平均为 64.7%，而在有界相对量纲上为 49.2%。 附录 B.2 定义了该指标；附录 E.2 给出了原始结果。

paragraphs.en: Solver improvements across a benchmark family. On the IWLS 2023 logic-synthesis task, Astra’s submitted program produces valid circuits on all 100 evaluation instances: it improves the task reference on 22, matches it on 31, and uses more AND gates than the reference on 47. In the original six-agent case-study cohort, each of the other agents’ submitted programs also passes all 100 validity checks, but only one Kimi K3 attempt and Grok 4.6 improve a reference, each on one instance. These counts describe the same program applied across a family of inputs. Appendix F.1 gives the circuit-level improvements and reference sources.
paragraphs.zh: 跨基准测试族的任务求解器改进。 在 IWLS 2023 逻辑综合任务上，Astra 提交的程序在全部 100 个评估实例上生成了有效电路：它在 22 个实例上改进了任务参考结果，在 31 个实例上与之持平，在 47 个实例上使用了比参考结果更多的与门。 在最初的六智能体案例研究队列中，其他智能体提交的程序也全部通过了全部 100 项有效性检查，但只有一次 Kimi K3 尝试和 Grok 4.6 改进了参考结果，各改进一个实例。 这些计数描述的是同一个程序在一族输入上的应用情况。 附录 F.1 给出了电路层面的改进情况和参考结果的来源。

paragraphs.en: More theorems are solved with additional statements and proof ideas. With three attempts on each of 20 theorems, Kimi K3 solves 3, 4, and 7 theorems at least once under bare, ladder, and guided, respectively; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 solves 0, 2, and 6. Guided also has the highest per-attempt complete-proof success: Kimi K3 succeeds in 18/60 attempts, compared with 7/60 under both ladder and bare. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 succeeds in 0/60 bare, 2/60 ladder, and 11/60 guided attempts. Appendix E.3 reports complete-proof outcomes, partial-credit scores, and individual proof attempts.

paragraphs.en: Graph and code results. In the Erdős girth-5 extremal-graph task, Kimi K3 constructs a 124-vertex, 630-edge graph without 3- or 4-cycles, exceeding the 629-edge reference ( Goedgebeur et al., 2025 ) . In the quantum stabilizer-code task, it constructs a binary [ [ 25 , 7 , 6 ] ] [[25,7,6]] code, increasing the minimum distance from 5 to 6 for a code on 25 qubits encoding seven logical qubits ( Grassl, n.d. ) (Figure 5 ). Astra also attains both parameters and proves that a binary code of length 22 and minimum Hamming distance 10 has at most 82 codewords ( A ⁡ ( 22 , 10 ) ≤ 82 A(22,10)\leq 82 ), improving the published upper bound of 84 ( Gijswijt et al., 2012 ) (Appendix D.3 ). Qwen3.8 Max (0902), Grok 4.6, and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 each obtain a 630-edge graph. Appendix F records provenance and shows Astra’s constructions.
paragraphs.zh: 图与代码的结果。 在 Erdős 围长为 5 的极图任务中，Kimi K3 构造了一个包含 124 个顶点、630 条边且不含 3-圈或 4-圈的图，超过了 629 条边的参考结果（Goedgebeur 等，2025）。 在量子稳定子码任务中，它构造了一个二元 [ [ 25 , 7 , 6 ] ] 码，将 25 个量子比特编码七个逻辑量子比特的码的最小距离从 5 提升到 6（Grassl，无日期）（图 5）。 Astra 同样达到了这两个参数，并证明了长度为 22、最小汉明距离为 10 的二元码至多包含 82 个码字（A(22,10)≤82），改进了已发表的 84 的上界（Gijswijt 等，2012）（附录 D.3）。 Qwen3.8 Max (0902)、Grok 4.6 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 各自得到了一个 630 条边的图。 附录 F 记录了来源并展示了 Astra 的构造。

paragraphs.en: Use of published counterexamples. During the network-enabled evaluations, Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 retrieved OpenAI’s published counterexamples and Lean proofs for Ryser and the modified integer round-up conjecture (MIRUP) ( OpenAI, 2026c ; OpenAI, 2026b ) . 2 2 2 The tasks were formulated before these OpenAI results were released; the Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek 1017 evaluations took place afterward. Their submissions adapt these existing results to the task definitions. The accepted adaptations comprise Ryser submissions from Kimi K3.1 Pro (1/3) and DeepSeek 1017 (2/3), and MIRUP submissions from DeepSeek 1017 (3/3; Table 15 ). The other 28 conjecture tasks have no accepted complete solution. OpenAI’s results highlight the potential for AI-assisted conjecture resolution. Future work could evaluate agents without Internet access on conjectures still open at the time of testing.
paragraphs.zh: 使用已发表的（数学）反例。 在联网评估中，Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 检索到了 OpenAI 已发表的反例，以及针对 Ryser 猜想和修正整数向上取整猜想（MIRUP）的 Lean 证明（OpenAI, 2026c；OpenAI, 2026b）。222 这些任务在 OpenAI 的相关结果发布之前即已拟定；对 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek 1017 的评估则在其后进行。 它们提交的解答将这些已有结果适配到任务定义之上。 获得接受的适配结果包括 Kimi K3.1 Pro（1/3）和 DeepSeek 1017（2/3）提交的 Ryser 解答，以及 DeepSeek 1017（3/3）提交的 MIRUP 解答（表 15）。 其余 28 个猜想任务均没有获得接受的完整解。 OpenAI 的结果凸显了 AI 辅助解决猜想的潜力。 未来的工作可以在测试时仍未解决的猜想上，评估无法访问互联网的智能体。

sents.zh: 在联网评估中，Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 检索到了 OpenAI 已发表的反例，以及针对 Ryser 猜想和修正整数向上取整猜想（MIRUP）的 Lean 证明（OpenAI, 2026c；OpenAI, 2026b）。222 这些任务在 OpenAI 的相关结果发布之前即已拟定；对 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek 1017 的评估则在其后进行。

sents.en: Their submissions adapt these existing results to the task definitions.
sents.zh: 它们提交的解答将这些已有结果适配到任务定义之上。

sents.en: The accepted adaptations comprise Ryser submissions from Kimi K3.1 Pro (1/3) and DeepSeek 1017 (2/3), and MIRUP submissions from DeepSeek 1017 (3/3; Table 15 ).
sents.zh: 获得接受的适配结果包括 Kimi K3.1 Pro（1/3）和 DeepSeek 1017（2/3）提交的 Ryser 解答，以及 DeepSeek 1017（3/3）提交的 MIRUP 解答（表 15）。

sents.en: The other 28 conjecture tasks have no accepted complete solution.
sents.zh: 其余 28 个猜想任务均没有获得接受的完整解。

sents.en: OpenAI’s results highlight the potential for AI-assisted conjecture resolution.
sents.zh: OpenAI 的结果凸显了 AI 辅助解决猜想的潜力。

sents.en: Future work could evaluate agents without Internet access on conjectures still open at the time of testing.
sents.zh: 未来的工作可以在测试时仍未解决的猜想上，评估无法访问互联网的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Verified special cases and bounds. While attempting the full conjecture, GPT-6 Astra proves the Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi conjecture over 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} for every n ≤ 9 n\leq 9 : every invertible n × n n\times n matrix A A admits a vector x x such that x x and A ​ x Ax have no zero coordinates. The n = 9 n=9 case extends the dimensional ranges n ≤ 7 n\leq 7 of Yu (1999) and n ≤ 8 n\leq 8 reported in a recent preprint ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) . The proof combines counting identities with an exact integer certificate to exclude a minimal counterexample (Figure 6 ). Independent Lean verification confirms the result using only standard axioms. Appendix F.3 gives the proof structure, formal verification, and its relation to prior work. Four further verified cases concern a six-variable Fourier entropy–influence bound, an exact high-rank Hilbert-matrix rigidity formula, an influence bound for quadratic polynomials, and finite-instance online-matching bounds (Appendix F.4 ). These five cases demonstrate that open-conjecture attempts can produce independently verifiable mathematical results. Analyzing their statements and proofs captures progress beyond the binary resolution score and identifies concrete results for further mathematical study.
paragraphs.zh: 验证了特殊情形与边界。 在尝试完整猜想的过程中，GPT-6 Astra 证明了 Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi 猜想在 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} 上对每个 n ≤ 9 n\leq 9 成立：每个可逆的 n × n n\times n 矩阵 A A 都存在向量 x x，使得 x x 与 A ​ x Ax 均无零坐标。 n = 9 n=9 的情形扩展了 Yu（1999）给出的 n ≤ 7 n\leq 7 以及一篇近期预印本（Zeng et al., 2026）中报告的 n ≤ 8 n\leq 8 的维度范围。 该证明将计数恒等式与一个精确的整数证书相结合，以排除最小反例（图 6）。 独立的 Lean 验证仅使用标准公理确认了该结果。 附录 F.3 给出了证明结构、形式化验证及其与先前工作的关系。 另有四个已验证的情形涉及一个六变量傅里叶熵–影响界、一个精确的高秩希尔伯特矩阵刚性公式、一个二次多项式的影响界，以及有限实例的在线匹配界（附录 F.4）。 这五个情形表明，开放猜想的尝试能够产生可独立验证的数学结果。 分析这些结果的陈述与证明，可以刻画超越二元解决得分的进展，并为进一步的数学研究确定具体成果。

paragraphs.en: TCSExam provides a unified, extensible framework for evaluating agents across the full range of TCS research, connecting theorem proving, solver engineering, and explicit constructions with open-conjecture settlement. Full comprises 100 expert-reviewed tasks with outcomes checked by the Lean kernel or executable checkers. Lite retains all four tracks in 20 tasks, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. Evaluations across nine agents reveal substantial differences in research capabilities, with strong Full–Lite rank agreement among the eight shared agents. Together, the suites support broad capability assessment and smaller-scale evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: TCSExam 提供了一个统一且可扩展的框架，用于评估智能体在 TCS 研究全范围内的能力，将定理证明、求解器工程与显式构造同公开猜想的解决连接起来。 Full 包含 100 个经过专家审阅的任务，其结果由 Lean 内核或可执行检查器验证。 Lite 在 20 个任务中保留了全部四个赛道，在相同的单次尝试预算下，将任务尝试次数减少了 80%。 对九个智能体的评估显示出研究能力上的显著差异，且八个共享智能体在 Full 与 Lite 之间的排名高度一致。 两套测试集共同支持广泛的能力评估与较小规模的评估。

paragraphs.en: The results show complementary strengths in proof completion, solver performance, and construction quality. Submitted programs and mathematical objects improve selected task references. For both agents in the proof-guidance study, supplying intermediate lemmas and proof ideas increases the number of theorems solved. Open-conjecture attempts also yield independently verified special cases and bounds, including Astra’s nine-dimensional Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi result over 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} . These outputs help characterize the research work agents can undertake and identify directions for further progress. The accompanying task sources, Docker build recipes, and evaluation tools support reproducible use and extension. Researchers can add problems through the shared task interfaces and verification protocols, extending this foundation for evaluating agents and studying their contributions to TCS research.
paragraphs.zh: 结果表明，在证明补全、求解器性能和构造质量方面各有所长，互为补充。 提交的程序和数学对象改进了部分选定的任务参考解答。 在证明指导研究中，对于两个智能体而言，提供中间引理和证明思路都能增加所解决的定理数量。 开放猜想的尝试也产生了经独立验证的特殊情形和界，其中包括 Astra 在 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} 上的九维 Alon–Jaeger–Tarsi 结果。 这些输出有助于刻画智能体能够承担的研究工作，并确定进一步进展的方向。 随附的任务来源、Docker 构建配方和评估工具支持可复现的使用与扩展。 研究人员可以通过共享的任务接口和验证协议添加问题，从而扩展这一基础，用于评估智能体并研究其对理论计算机科学（TCS）研究的贡献。

AI assistants also supported data processing, result analysis, manuscript drafting and editing, figure code, and literature search. Evaluated model outputs are identified as experimental submissions and checked under the relevant task protocol. Result tables and plots are generated programmatically from experiment records. The authors take responsibility for the final content of this work.

paragraphs.en: Theorem proving: corners-quasipoly. The task concerns the quantitative bound for corner-free sets of Jaber et al. (2025) and provides formal definitions and a fixed target theorem. Bare attempts must prove the target from the supplied mathematical context. Ladder and guided attempts additionally receive intermediate statements; guided attempts receive a proof idea. A local checkpoint proof is evaluated under the other checkpoint statements, whereas the complete-proof check excludes unproved checkpoint assumptions. The fixed target declaration and supplied assumptions determine the statement whose complete proof is scored.
paragraphs.zh: 定理证明：corners-quasipoly。 该任务涉及 Jaber 等人对无角集合的定量界。 (2025)，并提供形式化定义和一个固定的目标定理。 朴素尝试必须根据提供的数学背景证明该目标。 阶梯尝试和引导尝试还会收到中间命题；引导尝试会收到一个证明思路。 局部检查点证明是在其他检查点命题的条件下进行评估的，而完整证明检查则排除未经证明的检查点假设。 固定的目标声明和提供的假设共同确定了需要评分完整证明的那个命题。

paragraphs.en: Solver engineering: maxcut-mqlib. A submitted program receives a weighted graph from the MQLib collection ( Dunning et al., 2018 ) and returns a vertex partition. The checker validates the partition and recomputes the total weight of edges crossing the cut. Final judging applies the same program across the designated instance family under the task’s resource limits. The evaluation measures the program's performance across the instance family. The final manifest specifies public and held-out instance counts and the limits used for each set.

paragraphs.en: Open conjectures: log-rank-conjecture. paragraphs.en: For optimization instances, failed Kimi K3 attempts supply no numerical reference value. The comparison includes only instances with at least two valid reference values; the same eligible instance set is used for all models. Decision failures supply a reference outcome of zero. A failed candidate solution receives relative score zero directly, rather than being interpreted as a zero-cost solution. Missing judging records are reported separately and are not filled with numerical zeros. We transform each instance outcome before averaging over instances, then average attempts within tasks and give the 30 tasks equal weight. Reference coverage, feasibility outcomes, and the unbounded ratio scores accompany this comparison.

paragraphs.en: Final solver execution follows the task’s declared budget. Per-instance tasks limit each instance separately. Time-pool tasks permit allocation of a single total budget across the family; evaluation must preserve that allocation opportunity. Certificate requirements are also task-specific: for example, SAT unsatisfiability claims require the designated proof certificate and certificate checker. Final results use the final submitted program on the designated evaluation set.
paragraphs.zh: 最终求解器执行遵循任务声明的预算。 按实例计的任务对每个实例分别限制预算。 时间池任务允许在整个任务族范围内分配单一总预算；评估必须保留这种分配机会。 证书要求也是任务特定的：例如，SAT 不可满足性声明需要指定的证明证书和证书检查器。 最终结果使用最终提交的程序在指定评估集上得出。

sents.zh: 证书要求也是任务特定的：例如，SAT 不可满足性声明需要指定的证明证书和证书检查器。

sents.en: Final results use the final submitted program on the designated evaluation set.
sents.zh: 最终结果使用最终提交的程序在指定评估集上得出。

paragraphs.en: A task supplies a formal proposition P P and slots for P P and ¬ P \neg P . A valid proof in either direction earns 1; otherwise the complete-resolution score is 0. Each main slot is checked in isolation after removing its contradictory twin, without treating either unproved main statement as an assumption. Auxiliary statements may support the submitted proof only within the permitted verification context. Special cases, reductions, and counterexamples to related stronger statements are reported with their precise scope and do not change the binary target score.
paragraphs.zh: 任务给出一个形式化命题 P P 以及用于 P P 和 ¬ P \neg P 的槽位。 任一方向的有效证明得 1 分；否则完整解决分数为 0 分。 每个主槽位在移除其矛盾孪生命题后单独检查，不将任一未证明的主命题视为假设。 辅助命题只能在允许的验证范围内为所提交的证明提供支持。 特殊情形、归约以及与相关更强命题的反例须连同其精确适用范围一并报告，且不改变二元目标分数。

sents.en: A task supplies a formal proposition P P and slots for P P and ¬ P \neg P .
sents.zh: 任务给出一个形式化命题 P P 以及用于 P P 和 ¬ P \neg P 的槽位。

sents.en: A valid proof in either direction earns 1; otherwise the complete-resolution score is 0.
sents.zh: 任一方向的有效证明得 1 分；否则完整解决分数为 0 分。

sents.en: Each main slot is checked in isolation after removing its contradictory twin, without treating either unproved main statement as an assumption.
sents.zh: 每个主槽位在移除其矛盾孪生命题后单独检查，不将任一未证明的主命题视为假设。

sents.en: Auxiliary statements may support the submitted proof only within the permitted verification context.
sents.zh: 辅助命题只能在允许的验证范围内为所提交的证明提供支持。

sents.en: Special cases, reductions, and counterexamples to related stronger statements are reported with their precise scope and do not change the binary target score.
sents.zh: 特殊情形、归约以及与相关更强命题的反例须连同其精确适用范围一并报告，且不改变二元目标分数。

paragraphs.en: Agent-assisted source reviews identify the intended research claim, its quantifiers and parameter range, and the result or object accepted by the task. For formal statements, component reconciliation maps each source definition and assumption to the corresponding Lean declaration. Small examples and boundary cases check that definitions behave as intended. Re-translation provides an additional comparison between the source and its formalization. Some re-translation passes were performed by the authoring agent, while other reviews used a fresh context. Shared definitions and statements are checked across the three theorem-disclosure levels.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体辅助的来源审查会识别目标研究主张、其量词与参数范围，以及该任务所接受的结果或对象。 对于形式化陈述，组件核对将每个来源中的定义与假设映射到对应的 Lean 声明。 小型示例和边界情况用于检查定义是否按预期运作。 回译为来源与其形式化之间提供了额外的比较。 部分回译环节由撰写智能体执行，而其他审查则使用了全新的上下文。 共享的定义和陈述会在三个定理披露层级之间进行核对。

sents.en: Agent-assisted source reviews identify the intended research claim, its quantifiers and parameter range, and the result or object accepted by the task.
sents.zh: 智能体辅助的来源审查会识别目标研究主张、其量词与参数范围，以及该任务所接受的结果或对象。

sents.en: For formal statements, component reconciliation maps each source definition and assumption to the corresponding Lean declaration.
sents.zh: 对于形式化陈述，组件核对将每个来源中的定义与假设映射到对应的 Lean 声明。

sents.en: Small examples and boundary cases check that definitions behave as intended.
sents.zh: 小型示例和边界情况用于检查定义是否按预期运作。

sents.en: Re-translation provides an additional comparison between the source and its formalization.
sents.zh: 回译为来源与其形式化之间提供了额外的比较。

sents.en: Some re-translation passes were performed by the authoring agent, while other reviews used a fresh context.
sents.zh: 部分回译环节由撰写智能体执行，而其他审查则使用了全新的上下文。

sents.en: Shared definitions and statements are checked across the three theorem-disclosure levels.
sents.zh: 共享的定义和陈述会在三个定理披露层级之间进行核对。

paragraphs.en: Checker review exercises both valid and invalid submissions: empty outputs, malformed objects, incorrect objectives, incomplete certificates, and attempts to change fixed statements. Reference outputs are used where available. For open conjectures, development tests check the proof-or-refutation interface and its rejection of invalid submissions.
paragraphs.zh: 校验器评审同时涵盖有效与无效的提交：空输出、格式错误的对象、不正确的目标、不完整的证书，以及试图更改固定陈述的行为。 在有参考输出的情况下会使用参考输出。 对于未解决的猜想，开发测试会检查证明或反驳接口及其对无效提交的拒绝行为。

sents.en: Checker review exercises both valid and invalid submissions: empty outputs, malformed objects, incorrect objectives, incomplete certificates, and attempts to change fixed statements.
sents.zh: 校验器评审同时涵盖有效与无效的提交：空输出、格式错误的对象、不正确的目标、不完整的证书，以及试图更改固定陈述的行为。

sents.en: Reference outputs are used where available.
sents.zh: 在有参考输出的情况下会使用参考输出。

sents.en: For open conjectures, development tests check the proof-or-refutation interface and its rejection of invalid submissions.
sents.zh: 对于未解决的猜想，开发测试会检查证明或反驳接口及其对无效提交的拒绝行为。

paragraphs.en: A full proof or a value beyond the reference triggers agent-assisted re-examination of the rollout, submitted artifact, and task statement. The review checks adherence to the task rules, the accepted proof’s assumptions or the object’s verified properties, and the scope of the claimed result. For numerical improvements, source comparison checks the prior reference, problem parameters, instance set, and resource conditions. Mathematical validity and literature novelty are documented separately. If a statement or checker changes, the corrected task receives a new version; results on different versions retain their original scope.
paragraphs.zh: 完整证明或超出参考值的数值会触发智能体辅助复核，对 rollout、提交的成果和任务描述进行重新检查。 审查会检查对任务规则的遵守情况、所接受证明的前提假设或该对象的已验证属性，以及所声称结果的适用范围。 对于数值改进，来源对比会检查先前的参考值、问题参数、实例集合和资源条件。 数学有效性和文献新颖性分别记录。 如果陈述或检查器发生变更，修正后的任务将获得新版本；不同版本上的结果保留其原有范围。

sents.en: A full proof or a value beyond the reference triggers agent-assisted re-examination of the rollout, submitted artifact, and task statement.
sents.zh: 完整证明或超出参考值的数值会触发智能体辅助复核，对 rollout、提交的成果和任务描述进行重新检查。

sents.en: The review checks adherence to the task rules, the accepted proof’s assumptions or the object’s verified properties, and the scope of the claimed result.
sents.zh: 审查会检查对任务规则的遵守情况、所接受证明的前提假设或该对象的已验证属性，以及所声称结果的适用范围。

sents.en: For numerical improvements, source comparison checks the prior reference, problem parameters, instance set, and resource conditions.
sents.zh: 对于数值改进，来源对比会检查先前的参考值、问题参数、实例集合和资源条件。

sents.en: Mathematical validity and literature novelty are documented separately.
sents.zh: 数学有效性和文献新颖性分别记录。

sents.en: If a statement or checker changes, the corrected task receives a new version; results on different versions retain their original scope.
sents.zh: 如果陈述或检查器发生变更，修正后的任务将获得新版本；不同版本上的结果保留其原有范围。

paragraphs.en: Development checks sometimes identified apparent missing boundary conditions, discrepancies between definitions and their use in proofs, or potential gaps in arguments. We treated these as concerns requiring source reconciliation, including checks for mistakes in our own formalization. Candidate tasks were excluded when such concerns could not be resolved. This source-reconciliation process informed task selection and formalization.
paragraphs.zh: 开发核查有时会识别出明显缺失的边界条件、定义与其在证明中的使用之间的不一致，或论证中潜在的漏洞。 我们将这些视为需要与原始来源进行核对的问题，包括检查我们自己的形式化中是否存在错误。 当此类问题无法解决时，候选任务会被排除。 这一与原始来源核对的过程为任务的选择和形式化提供了依据。

sents.en: Development checks sometimes identified apparent missing boundary conditions, discrepancies between definitions and their use in proofs, or potential gaps in arguments.
sents.zh: 开发核查有时会识别出明显缺失的边界条件、定义与其在证明中的使用之间的不一致，或论证中潜在的漏洞。

sents.en: We treated these as concerns requiring source reconciliation, including checks for mistakes in our own formalization.
sents.zh: 我们将这些视为需要与原始来源进行核对的问题，包括检查我们自己的形式化中是否存在错误。

sents.en: Candidate tasks were excluded when such concerns could not be resolved.
sents.zh: 当此类问题无法解决时，候选任务会被排除。

sents.en: This source-reconciliation process informed task selection and formalization.
sents.zh: 这一与原始来源核对的过程为任务的选择和形式化提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: The theorem collection was screened through pilot evaluations, with over 40 theorem problems retired across development rounds. The evaluation records retain the screening model and configuration, candidate and included task lists, and reasons for retirement. Because pilot performance informed task selection, the collection is conditioned on the screening agent's outcomes, which can affect its comparison with other agents. Task additions and retirements are recorded without changing historical evaluation manifests.
paragraphs.zh: 定理集合经过试点评估筛选，在多轮开发过程中淘汰了超过 40 道定理题目。 评估记录保留了筛选所用的模型与配置、候选与入选任务列表，以及淘汰原因。 由于试点表现影响了任务选择，该集合以筛选智能体的结果为条件，这可能影响它与其他智能体的比较。 任务的增删均有记录，且不改变历史评估清单。

sents.en: The theorem collection was screened through pilot evaluations, with over 40 theorem problems retired across development rounds.
sents.zh: 定理集合经过试点评估筛选，在多轮开发过程中淘汰了超过 40 道定理题目。

sents.en: The evaluation records retain the screening model and configuration, candidate and included task lists, and reasons for retirement.
sents.zh: 评估记录保留了筛选所用的模型与配置、候选与入选任务列表，以及淘汰原因。

sents.en: Because pilot performance informed task selection, the collection is conditioned on the screening agent's outcomes, which can affect its comparison with other agents.
sents.zh: 由于试点表现影响了任务选择，该集合以筛选智能体的结果为条件，这可能影响它与其他智能体的比较。

sents.en: Task additions and retirements are recorded without changing historical evaluation manifests.
sents.zh: 任务的增删均有记录，且不改变历史评估清单。

paragraphs.en: The project repository ( https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam ) provides task statements, Full and Lite suite definitions, Dockerfiles, data recipes, judging code, and evaluation commands. Users build environments on a Linux Docker host and configure their model provider and harness. The 100 logical tasks are packaged as 70 Lean tasks and 60 Solver variants, with Online and Offline versions for each Solver problem.
paragraphs.zh: 项目仓库（https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam）提供了任务说明、Full 与 Lite 套件的定义、Dockerfile、数据配方、判题代码以及评测命令。 用户在 Linux Docker 主机上构建环境，并配置其模型提供商与执行框架（harness）。 这 100 个逻辑任务被封装为 70 个 Lean 任务和 60 个 Solver 变体，其中每个 Solver 题目均有在线（Online）和离线（Offline）两个版本。

sents.en: The project repository ( https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam ) provides task statements, Full and Lite suite definitions, Dockerfiles, data recipes, judging code, and evaluation commands.
sents.zh: 项目仓库（https://github.com/MoonshotAI/TCSExam）提供了任务说明、Full 与 Lite 套件的定义、Dockerfile、数据配方、判题代码以及评测命令。

sents.en: Users build environments on a Linux Docker host and configure their model provider and harness.
sents.zh: 用户在 Linux Docker 主机上构建环境，并配置其模型提供商与执行框架（harness）。

sents.en: The 100 logical tasks are packaged as 70 Lean tasks and 60 Solver variants, with Online and Offline versions for each Solver problem.
sents.zh: 这 100 个逻辑任务被封装为 70 个 Lean 任务和 60 个 Solver 变体，其中每个 Solver 题目均有在线（Online）和离线（Offline）两个版本。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation includes eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. Each attempt has a development budget of up to 12 hours. General Internet access is disabled for theorem and solver tasks and enabled for construction and conjecture tasks. Agents use the supplied tools and libraries within the task rules. Solver judging has separate task-specific time and hardware limits.
paragraphs.zh: 评估在 Full 上包含八个智能体，在 Lite 上包含九个智能体。 每次尝试的开发预算最多为 12 小时。 定理和求解器任务禁用通用互联网访问，构造和猜想任务则启用通用互联网访问。 智能体在任务规则允许的范围内使用提供的工具和库。 求解器的评判设有独立的针对任务的时间和硬件限制。

sents.en: The evaluation includes eight agents on Full and nine on Lite.
sents.zh: 评估在 Full 上包含八个智能体，在 Lite 上包含九个智能体。

sents.en: Each attempt has a development budget of up to 12 hours.
sents.zh: 每次尝试的开发预算最多为 12 小时。

sents.en: General Internet access is disabled for theorem and solver tasks and enabled for construction and conjecture tasks.
sents.zh: 定理和求解器任务禁用通用互联网访问，构造和猜想任务则启用通用互联网访问。

sents.en: Agents use the supplied tools and libraries within the task rules.
sents.zh: 智能体在任务规则允许的范围内使用提供的工具和库。

sents.en: Solver judging has separate task-specific time and hardware limits.
sents.zh: 求解器的评判设有独立的针对任务的时间和硬件限制。

paragraphs.en: Grok 4.6 uses the Grok Build harness with thinking enabled and reasoning effort set to xhigh. Agent development budgets and final solver execution budgets are recorded separately. Each result is associated with its task definition, submitted output, verification outcome, and resource use.
paragraphs.zh: Grok 4.6 使用 Grok Build 框架，开启思考模式，并将推理力度设置为 xhigh。 智能体开发预算与最终求解器执行预算分别记录。 每个结果都与其任务定义、提交的输出、验证结果和资源使用相关联。

sents.en: Grok 4.6 uses the Grok Build harness with thinking enabled and reasoning effort set to xhigh.
sents.zh: Grok 4.6 使用 Grok Build 框架，开启思考模式，并将推理力度设置为 xhigh。

sents.en: Agent development budgets and final solver execution budgets are recorded separately.
sents.zh: 智能体开发预算与最终求解器执行预算分别记录。

sents.en: Each result is associated with its task definition, submitted output, verification outcome, and resource use.
sents.zh: 每个结果都与其任务定义、提交的输出、验证结果和资源使用相关联。

paragraphs.en: The solver collection comprises 19 competition-derived tasks and 11 tasks based on instance libraries. Source type and execution budget are separate choices: either type can use per-instance limits or a shared time pool. Each task specifies a public development set, a final evaluation set, an executable submission interface, and a checker. Competition-derived tasks can retain the source’s development/test distinction or define a new split of released instances. Library-derived tasks define their own splits; these are fixed in the task version rather than selected from model outcomes. Table 10 records the evaluated configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器集合包含 19 个源自竞赛的任务和 11 个基于实例库的任务。 来源类型与执行预算是相互独立的选择：两种类型均可使用逐实例限额或共享时间池。 每个任务都规定了公开的开发集、最终评估集、可执行的提交接口以及校验器。 源自竞赛的任务可以保留原竞赛的开发集/测试集划分，也可以对已发布的实例重新定义划分。 源自实例库的任务自行定义划分；这些划分在任务版本中固定，而非根据模型结果来选取。 表 10 记录了被评估的配置。

sents.en: The solver collection comprises 19 competition-derived tasks and 11 tasks based on instance libraries.
sents.zh: 求解器集合包含 19 个源自竞赛的任务和 11 个基于实例库的任务。

sents.en: Source type and execution budget are separate choices: either type can use per-instance limits or a shared time pool.
sents.zh: 来源类型与执行预算是相互独立的选择：两种类型均可使用逐实例限额或共享时间池。

sents.en: Each task specifies a public development set, a final evaluation set, an executable submission interface, and a checker.
sents.zh: 每个任务都规定了公开的开发集、最终评估集、可执行的提交接口以及校验器。

sents.en: Competition-derived tasks can retain the source’s development/test distinction or define a new split of released instances.
sents.zh: 源自竞赛的任务可以保留原竞赛的开发集/测试集划分，也可以对已发布的实例重新定义划分。

sents.en: Library-derived tasks define their own splits; these are fixed in the task version rather than selected from model outcomes.
sents.zh: 源自实例库的任务自行定义划分；这些划分在任务版本中固定，而非根据模型结果来选取。

sents.en: Table 10 records the evaluated configurations.
sents.zh: 表 10 记录了被评估的配置。

paragraphs.en: Public instances and self-test results are available during program development. Hidden instance files and transformation parameters remain on the judging side, outside the agent’s development environment. Public development and final evaluation use disjoint sets of source instances.
paragraphs.zh: 公开实例和自测结果可在程序开发期间获得。 隐藏实例文件和变换参数保留在评测方一侧，位于智能体的开发环境之外。 公开开发和最终评测使用互不相交的源实例集合。

sents.en: Public instances and self-test results are available during program development.
sents.zh: 公开实例和自测结果可在程序开发期间获得。

sents.en: Hidden instance files and transformation parameters remain on the judging side, outside the agent’s development environment.
sents.zh: 隐藏实例文件和变换参数保留在评测方一侧，位于智能体的开发环境之外。

sents.en: Public development and final evaluation use disjoint sets of source instances.
sents.zh: 公开开发和最终评测使用互不相交的源实例集合。

paragraphs.en: The quadratic-assignment task illustrates the conversion of a public library into a solver evaluation. From 136 QAPLIB instances ( Burkard et al., 1997 ) , the versioned split assigns 41 to hidden evaluation, 75 to public development, and 20 to neither set. Hidden selection is stratified by instance family and size; withholding the third group prevents the public complement from identifying the evaluation set exactly. Hidden instances independently permute facility and location indices. If π \pi relabels facilities and σ \sigma relabels locations, a feasible assignment p p becomes p ′ = σ ∘ p ∘ π − 1 p^{\prime}=\sigma\circ p\circ\pi^{-1} . Applying the same relabelings to the flow and distance matrices preserves every assignment’s cost and the optimal value. The checker validates the submitted permutation and recomputes its cost on the transformed instance.
paragraphs.zh: 二次分配任务展示了将一个公共库转换为求解器评估的过程。 在 136 个 QAPLIB 实例（Burkard et al., 1997）中，带版本的划分将 41 个分配给隐藏评估，75 个分配给公共开发，20 个不属于任一集合。 隐藏集合的选择按实例家族和规模进行分层；保留第三组可以防止公共补集精确识别出评估集合。 隐藏实例独立地置换设施索引和位置索引。 如果 π \pi 对设施重新标记，σ \sigma 对位置重新标记，则一个可行分配 p p 变为 p ′ = σ ∘ p ∘ π − 1 p^{\prime}=\sigma\circ p\circ\pi^{-1} 。 对流量矩阵和距离矩阵应用相同的重新标记，可保持每个分配的成本和最优值不变。 检查器验证提交的排列，并在变换后的实例上重新计算其成本。

sents.zh: 二次分配任务展示了将一个公共库转换为求解器评估的过程。

sents.zh: 如果 π \pi 对设施重新标记，σ \sigma 对位置重新标记，则一个可行分配 p p 变为 p ′ = σ ∘ p ∘ π − 1 p^{\prime}=\sigma\circ p\circ\pi^{-1} 。

paragraphs.en: Other transformations follow the problem’s structure, such as vertex relabeling for graph problems and item reordering for bin packing. These changes obstruct direct reuse of answers in the original indexing. Training exposure to the public source instances is unknown. The submission rules require computation during judging and prohibit replay of stored final answers; hidden access controls, transformations, and rollout audits support compliance at complementary stages.
paragraphs.zh: 其他变换则遵循问题的结构，例如图问题中的顶点重标记和装箱问题中的物品重排序。 这些改变使得无法直接复用原有索引中的答案。 模型在训练中接触公开源实例的情况尚不清楚。 提交规则要求在评测期间进行计算，并禁止重放已存储的最终答案；隐藏的访问控制、变换以及rollout审计在互补的环节中支持合规性。

paragraphs.en: The 12-hour budget covers model interaction and program development. Afterward, the frozen program is rebuilt and evaluated under the task’s separate execution limits. Twenty-four tasks impose limits independently on each instance. Six tasks instead share one total time pool: bin packing, graph partitioning, sports timetabling, logic synthesis, quadratic assignment, and set cover. The judge processes the evaluation family while tracking the remaining pool, which is supplied to the program on each invocation. Time saved on one instance is available to later instances; these tasks are evaluated as one group to preserve this allocation rule. For example, quadratic assignment has 1,230 seconds across its 41 final instances, with no separate 30-second cutoff per instance. Glass cutting uses two runs per instance, at 180 and 3,600 seconds, with weights 0.1 and 0.9. Table 10 specifies each task’s final execution time budget.
paragraphs.zh: 12 小时的预算涵盖模型交互与程序开发。 之后，冻结的程序会被重建，并在该任务单独的执行限制下进行评估。 二十四个任务对每个实例独立施加限制。 六个任务则共享一个总时间池：装箱、图划分、体育赛程安排、逻辑综合、二次分配和集合覆盖。 评判程序在处理评估族的同时跟踪剩余时间池，并在每次调用时将其提供给程序。 在一个实例上节省的时间可供后续实例使用；这些任务作为一个整体进行评估，以保留这一分配规则。 例如，二次分配在其 41 个最终实例上共有 1,230 秒，并没有对每个实例单独设置 30 秒的时限。 玻璃切割对每个实例进行两次运行，分别为 180 秒和 3,600 秒，权重分别为 0.1 和 0.9。 表 10 给出了每个任务的最终执行时间预算。

paragraphs.en: For per-instance evaluation, we use up to ten isolated sandboxes concurrently, using ten whenever the number of instances and available resources permit. Each instance retains the specified time, CPU, and memory limits. Shared-pool tasks remain in one evaluation group to preserve cross-instance time allocation.

paragraphs.en: Full Solver evaluation uses the repetition counts in Table 9 : 480 submitted programs across eight agents. The 30 problems contain 1,870 final instances. The original six-agent cohort contributes ten attempts per problem in total: 300 programs and 10 × 1,870 = 18,700 10\times 1{,}870=18{,}700 instance outcomes. The detailed raw-outcome diagnostics in Appendix E.2 use this cohort. Table 13 includes all eight agents. Lite has five Solver tasks. Both suites use public self-tests during development and a single final evaluation per attempt; Section 4 describes their service-based and local self-test execution. Each submitted program is evaluated under the task’s time and hardware limits. Independent checks of the evaluation records verify instance membership, solution validity, objective values, and aggregation.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的求解器（Solver）评估使用表 9 中的重复次数：跨八个智能体共提交了 480 个程序。 这 30 道题目包含 1,870 个最终实例。 最初的六智能体团队在每道题目上总共贡献十次尝试：即 300 个程序以及 10 × 1,870 = 18,700 10\times 1{,}870=18{,}700 个实例结果。 附录 E.2 中详细的原始结果诊断使用了该团队的数据。 表 13 包含全部八个智能体。 Lite 包含五个求解器任务。 两个题集在开发阶段均使用公开的自测，并且每次尝试只进行一次最终评估；第 4 节描述了它们基于服务的和本地的自测执行方式。 每个提交的程序都在该任务的时间和硬件限制下进行评估。 对评估记录的独立核查验证了实例归属、解的有效性、目标值以及聚合结果。

paragraphs.en: Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 each contribute three attempts in each of the three settings on 20 theorems, giving 60 bare, 60 ladder, and 60 guided attempts per agent. Guided and ladder share their task definitions and main targets, with guided additionally supplying proof ideas.
paragraphs.zh: Kimi K3 与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 0910 在 20 条定理的三种设置中各贡献三次尝试，因此每个智能体得到 60 次裸尝试、60 次阶梯尝试和 60 次引导尝试。 引导与阶梯共享相同的任务定义和主要目标，区别在于引导额外提供证明思路。

paragraphs.en: An accepted assembled proof or direct main proof counts as a complete-proof success. The per-attempt rate divides successful attempts by 60; theorem coverage counts targets with at least one success among the three attempts. All submitted proofs are checked using the task’s fixed definitions and permitted axioms. Complete-proof outcomes and partial-credit task scores are reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受的组装证明或直接主证明视为完整证明成功。 单次尝试成功率将成功尝试次数除以 60；定理覆盖率统计在三次尝试中至少成功一次的目标。 所有提交的证明均使用该任务的固定定义和允许的公理进行检验。 完整证明结果与部分得分任务分数分别报告。

paragraphs.en: The original six-agent cohort receives construction prompts that describe published reference bounds but omit the numerical score transformation. The 12-hour development budget applies to producing the submitted object and certificate. In this original cohort, post-submission verification evaluates mathematical validity with extended compilation where needed. Acceptance requires the unchanged submitted artifact to satisfy the task statement, fixed-context checks, and permitted proof dependencies. Scores use these verified outcomes, and reference improvements are distinguished from matching the reference within the stated numerical tolerance.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的六个智能体队列接收到的构建提示描述了已发布的参考界，但省略了数值分数转换。 12 小时的开发预算适用于生成所提交的对象和证书。 在这个原始队列中，提交后的验证会在需要时通过扩展编译来评估数学有效性。 接受要求未经更改的提交工件满足任务说明、固定上下文检查以及允许的证明依赖。 分数使用这些经过验证的结果，并且参考改进与在规定数值容差内匹配参考被区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The theorem and construction plots show variation across tasks; repeated attempts additionally show within-task variation for agents evaluated more than once. paragraphs.en: The tables and Figures 7 and 8 include all eight Full agents. Kimi K3.1 Pro solves nine theorem tasks: all three attempts on six tasks, two on Dijkstra and three taxis, and one on strategy improvement. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 solves discrepancy twice and discrete bidding and the QMA–QCMA oracle task once each. For theorem proving, Kimi K3 completes the negations theorem in all three attempts, and universal Dijkstra and discrete bidding games in two attempts each. Its seven successful attempts therefore cover three distinct theorems. Grok 4.6 and GLM-5.3 each complete the discrete-bidding theorem, while Qwen3.8 Max (0902) completes the negations theorem. For constructions, the matrix distinguishes repeated attainment of the reference score from variation across attempts, including the occasional scores above 100.0%. Appendix F presents the achieved objects, mathematical parameters, and comparisons with their reference sources.
paragraphs.zh: 各表格及图7和图8包含了全部八个 Full 智能体。 Kimi K3.1 Pro 解决了九项定理任务：六项任务全部三次尝试均成功，Dijkstra 成功两次、三辆出租车成功三次，策略改进成功一次。 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 两次解决 discrepancy，discrete bidding 和 QMA–QCMA oracle 任务各成功一次。 在定理证明方面，Kimi K3 在全部三次尝试中均完成 negations 定理，并以各两次尝试完成 universal Dijkstra 和 discrete bidding 博弈。 因此，其七次成功尝试覆盖了三个不同的定理。 Grok 4.6 和 GLM-5.3 各自完成了 discrete-bidding 定理，而 Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 完成了 negations 定理。 对于构造类任务，矩阵区分了重复达到参考分数与多次尝试之间的差异，包括偶尔出现的超过 100.0% 的分数。 附录 F 展示了所实现的对象、数学参数以及与各自参考来源的比较。

paragraphs.en: Table 17 separates producing valid optimization outputs from meeting a certificate-based target. For each optimization attempt, we compute the fraction of judged instances with accepted feasible solutions, then average attempts within tasks and tasks equally. An attempt contributes to the full-set count only if every instance has a valid result. Across the 27 optimization tasks, Astra’s mean validity is 99.3%, compared with 93.9–97.5% for the other agents in Table 17 ; it returns valid solutions on every instance in 24 tasks. The three certificate-based tasks instead require the designated correctness or target certificate; their binary completion rates are reported separately. These statistics describe reliability across the instances of each problem, while objective values measure solution quality.
paragraphs.zh: 表17将产出有效优化结果与达成基于证书的目标区分开来。 对于每次优化尝试，我们计算被判定实例中拥有被接受可行解的比例，然后对任务内的各尝试取平均，再对各任务等权平均。 只有当每个实例都有有效结果时，该尝试才计入全集计数。 在27个优化任务中，Astra的平均有效率为99.3%，而表17中其他智能体为93.9–97.5%；它在24个任务中于所有实例上均返回有效解。 三个基于证书的任务则要求指定的正确性或目标证书；其二值完成率单独报告。 这些统计量描述每个问题各实例上的可靠性，而目标值衡量解的质量。

paragraphs.en: The Kimi K3-relative comparison uses a common set of 1,838 judged instances for every model. The excluded 32 instances lack two valid numerical Kimi K3 outcomes, which are required to estimate the sample standard deviation in Appendix B.2 . On 23 maximum-satisfiability instances, all three attempts are rejected because the output lacks the required objective-value line. Among nine sports-timetabling instances, eight have no feasible Kimi K3 solution and one has only a single feasible solution; the other submissions violate hard constraints. These are recorded unsuccessful solutions, with no missing judging records. We exclude these instances from every model’s relative score to maintain a common comparison set. Their outcomes remain in the raw records and failure counts, and the original task-score rules remain unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: Kimi K3 相对比较对每个模型使用同一组共 1,838 个已评判实例。 被排除的 32 个实例缺少两个有效的 Kimi K3 数值结果，而估计附录 B.2 中的样本标准差需要这些结果。 在 23 个最大可满足性实例上，所有三次尝试都被拒绝，因为输出缺少所要求的目标值行。 在九个体育赛程安排实例中，八个没有可行的 Kimi K3 解，一个只有一个可行解；其他提交结果违反了硬约束。 这些是被记录为未成功的解，没有缺失的评判记录。 我们将这些实例从每个模型的相对得分中排除，以维持一个共同的比较集合。 它们的结果仍保留在原始记录和失败计数中，且原始任务评分规则保持不变。

paragraphs.en: Table 19 illustrates how raw instance outcomes enter the unbounded ratio score. paragraphs.en: For Dijkstra, static comparison across the bare and scaffolded task versions confirms that the main statement and shared definitions agree after renaming the external interval-DAG bound and its bound variable; the scaffolded tasks additionally define the heap operations used by their checkpoints. The negations statements and shared definitions agree without renaming. These checks establish a common formal target for each case while retaining the differences in supplied context, prompts, and verifiers. In both selected tasks, the source verifiers award full credit to an accepted direct main proof as well as to an assembled proof. Submissions can therefore earn full credit through either proof route.

paragraphs.en: The target asks for a budget-agnostic winning strategy, whose action depends on the current vertex and tie-breaking advantage rather than the exact available budget. Theorem 27 of Avni & Sadhukhan (2026) constructs this strategy by applying value iteration at a trimmed threshold budget. Its proof tracks the excess budget, which is nondecreasing and bounded, and partitions play into intervals on which this quantity stays constant. This gives the initial energy bound M = ( k + 1 ) ​ ( W + H ) M=(k+1)(W+H) , where k k is the total integer budget, W W bounds absolute edge weights, and H H is the maximum energy threshold at the threshold budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 目标要求给出一个与预算无关的获胜策略，其动作取决于当前顶点和平局裁决优势，而不是确切的可用预算。 Avni & Sadhukhan（2026）的定理 27 通过在修剪后的阈值预算处应用值迭代来构造该策略。 其证明跟踪超额预算，该量是非减且有界的，并将博弈过程划分为多个区间，在每个区间上该量保持不变。 由此得到初始能量上界 M=(k+1)(W+H)，其中 k 是总整数预算，W 是边权绝对值的上界，H 是各阈值预算处的最大能量阈值。

paragraphs.en: One successful bare submission uses the same strategy and bound but organizes the argument as a single inductive invariant. paragraphs.en: The third ladder attempt provides a concrete comparison. Its final judge log accepts all seven intermediate checkpoints, including the value-iteration fixed point, the budget invariant, and the threshold-average property. The main theorem remains a sorry placeholder, and both complete-proof checks fail; the exact checkpoint fraction 7 / 8 7/8 corresponds to 87.5% (the historical score export rounds this to 88.0% in Table 22 ). Near the end of the 12-hour budget, the last build still reports the unfinished declaration and the final response records the target as incomplete. Thus this attempt’s partial credit comes from intermediate obligations that were accepted conditionally, while the final strategy-existence argument was not completed. Against the same formal target, the successful bare submission completes its invariant argument, while this independent ladder attempt leaves the final strategy-existence obligation open. In the second guided attempt, the model proposed the auxiliary lemma muN_kStar_le_xN , then identified a counterexample involving tie-breaking. The lemma was absent from the supplied task; the attempt exhausted its budget while revising the proof. A third guided attempt worked in auxiliary Lean files but left the designated submission unchanged, yielding no accepted checkpoints. This distinguishes unfinished mathematical obligations from failure to integrate working files into the submitted artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 第三次阶梯尝试提供了一个具体的对比。 其最终的裁判日志接受了全部七个中间检查点，包括值迭代不动点、预算不变量以及阈值平均值性质。 主定理仍是一个 sorry 占位符，且两个完整证明检查均失败；精确的检查点比例 7 / 8 7/8 对应于 87.5%（历史分数导出在表 22 中将其四舍五入为 88.0%）。 在 12 小时预算接近尾声时，最后一次构建仍报告该未完成的声明，最终回复将目标记录为未完成。 因此，这次尝试的部分得分来自被有条件接受的中间义务，而最终策略存在性论证并未完成。 针对同一个形式化目标，成功的裸提交完成了其不变量论证，而这次独立的阶梯尝试则将最终策略存在性义务保持为未决。 在第二次引导尝试中，模型提出了辅助引理 muN_kStar_le_xN ，随后发现了一个涉及平局裁决的反例。 该引理并不在所给任务中；这次尝试在修订证明的过程中耗尽了其预算。 第三次引导尝试在辅助 Lean 文件中工作，但保持指定的提交内容不变，因而没有得到任何被接受的检查点。 这区分了未完成的数学义务与未能将可用文件整合进提交产物这两种情况。

paragraphs.en: The solver examples use three logic-synthesis submissions from the designated evaluation. GPT-6 Astra reduces the AND-gate count from 138 to 108 on instance ex59 ; Kimi K3 reduces it from 19 to 18 on ex30 ; Grok 4.6 reduces it from 51 to 50 on ex68 . The corresponding reductions are 21.7%, 5.3%, and 2.0%. Each reference is the minimum count across the four teams’ publicly released AIG-track circuits in the IWLS 2023 repository ( IWLS 2023 Contest Organizers, 2023 ) . We downloaded all twelve reference circuits at commit 7dbfd510e259 and read their AND counts from the AIGER headers. Google’s submission attains all three minima, with the other teams tying on ex30 . The released files and their checksums accompany the case data.
paragraphs.zh: 求解器示例使用了指定评测中的三个逻辑综合提交结果。 GPT-6 Astra 在实例 ex59 上将与门数量从 138 减少到 108；Kimi K3 在 ex30 上将其从 19 减少到 18；Grok 4.6 在 ex68 上将其从 51 减少到 50。 对应的降幅分别为 21.7%、5.3% 和 2.0%。 每个参考值是 IWLS 2023 代码库中四个团队公开发布的 AIG 赛道电路的最小与门数量（IWLS 2023 Contest Organizers, 2023）。 我们在提交 7dbfd510e259 处下载了全部十二个参考电路，并从 AIGER 头部读取了它们的与门数量。 Google 的提交结果在全部三个实例上均达到最小值，其中其他团队在 ex30 上与之持平。 发布的文件及其校验和随案例数据一同提供。

paragraphs.en: For each quantum code, the 18 submitted pairs of binary masks are converted directly to Pauli letters, with qubits 1–25 corresponding to bits 0–24. Each matrix retains the submitted row order. Independent checks confirm binary rank 18 and pairwise commutation, yielding 25 − 18 = 7 25-18=7 logical qubits. The archived verifiers certify distance at least 6; independent distance checks corroborate this value. The edge lists, generator masks, source checksums, and drawing checks accompany the two figure data files. Astra's generator masks are also available in the public case data .

paragraphs.en: Astra’s submission proves A ⁡ ( 22 , 10 ) ≤ 82 A(22,10)\leq 82 . Here A ⁡ ( 22 , 10 ) A(22,10) is the largest possible number of binary words of length 22 with pairwise Hamming distance at least 10. The published semidefinite-programming bound is 84 ( Gijswijt et al., 2012 ) , also listed in Brouwer’s table when checked on September 26, 2026 ( Brouwer, n.d. ) . The verified upper-bound score is 101.6%. The same submission supplies a 64-word code, which gives a separate lower bound. The construction verification protocol is described in Appendix D.3 .

paragraphs.en: The 71-module source project was rebuilt in a clean sandbox using Lean 4.33.0-rc1 and public mathlib revision 5b3f719b , without reusing model-generated compiled files. The clean build used a 30 GB memory limit. The three declarations establishing the result over 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} , its prime-field extension, and the minimum counterexample dimension depend only on propext , Classical.choice , and Quot.sound . Their dependency audits contain no sorryAx or additional axioms and do not depend on the unresolved conjecture slots. The definition of the required nowhere-zero vector agrees with the original task. Separate integer checks reproduce the certificate and the inequalities over the 5,005 class-count vectors.
paragraphs.zh: 这个包含 71 个模块的源项目在一个干净的沙箱中使用 Lean 4.33.0-rc1 和公开的 mathlib 版本 5b3f719b 重新构建，没有复用模型生成的编译文件。 干净构建使用了 30 GB 的内存限制。 在 𝔽 5 \mathbb{F}_{5} 上确立该结果的三个声明、其素域扩张以及最小反例维度，仅依赖 propext、Classical.choice 和 Quot.sound。 它们的依赖审计中不含 sorryAx 或额外公理，也不依赖未解决的猜想占位符。 所需的 nowhere-zero 向量的定义与原始任务一致。 单独的整数检查在 5,005 个类计数向量上复现了该证书及各不等式。

paragraphs.en: We independently verify four further mathematical results from Astra's open-conjecture attempts: explicit inequalities, an exact rigidity formula, and finite-instance matching bounds. Clean source builds and axiom audits accept these statements using Lean's standard axioms, independently of the unresolved conjecture slots. The statements and proof methods are given below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们独立验证了来自 Astra 开放猜想尝试的另外四个数学结果：显式不等式、一个精确的刚性公式，以及有限实例的匹配界。 干净的源码构建与公理审计表明，这些命题在使用 Lean 标准公理的情况下即可被接受，而不依赖于那些未解决的猜想占位符。 相关命题及证明方法如下所示。

Here H H is the Shannon entropy of the squared Fourier coefficients, using natural logarithms, and I ( f ) = ∑ i Pr [ f ( X ) ≠ f ( X ⊕ i ) ] I(f)=\sum_{i}\Pr[f(X)\neq f(X^{\oplus i})] is the total influence under uniform X X . Equivalently, the constant is 7 when entropy is measured in bits.
