paragraphs.en: An extension specifies the research question and source, submission type, accepted evidence, scoring rule, and execution resources. It then follows the development checks in Appendix C : source correspondence, executable validation, negative tests, trial evaluation, and expert review. The task manifest records its field and parameter coverage so that extensions can increase both breadth and depth without changing the meaning of existing scores.
paragraphs.zh: 扩展（extension）指定研究问题与来源、提交类型、可接受的证据、评分规则以及执行资源。 随后遵循附录 C 中的开发检查：来源对应、可执行验证、负面测试、试运行评估以及专家评审。 任务清单（task manifest）记录其字段与参数覆盖范围，使扩展能够在不改变现有评分含义的前提下同时提升广度与深度。

sents.en: An extension specifies the research question and source, submission type, accepted evidence, scoring rule, and execution resources.
sents.zh: 扩展（extension）指定研究问题与来源、提交类型、可接受的证据、评分规则以及执行资源。

sents.en: It then follows the development checks in Appendix C : source correspondence, executable validation, negative tests, trial evaluation, and expert review.
sents.zh: 随后遵循附录 C 中的开发检查：来源对应、可执行验证、负面测试、试运行评估以及专家评审。

sents.en: The task manifest records its field and parameter coverage so that extensions can increase both breadth and depth without changing the meaning of existing scores.
sents.zh: 任务清单（task manifest）记录其字段与参数覆盖范围，使扩展能够在不改变现有评分含义的前提下同时提升广度与深度。

paragraphs.en: New problems use the corresponding output interface: a formal proof, a reusable solver, an explicit object with verified properties, or a proof or refutation of a conjecture. A task combining several methods still specifies exactly what must be submitted and what the checker establishes. This permits research workflows to vary while the evaluated output remains explicit.
paragraphs.zh: 新问题使用相应的输出接口：形式化证明、可复用的求解器、具有已验证属性的显式对象，或对某个猜想的证明或反驳。 结合多种方法的任务仍然明确规定了必须提交的内容以及检查器所确认的内容。 这允许研究工作流程各不相同，同时被评估的输出保持明确。

sents.en: New problems use the corresponding output interface: a formal proof, a reusable solver, an explicit object with verified properties, or a proof or refutation of a conjecture.
sents.zh: 新问题使用相应的输出接口：形式化证明、可复用的求解器、具有已验证属性的显式对象，或对某个猜想的证明或反驳。

sents.en: A task combining several methods still specifies exactly what must be submitted and what the checker establishes.
sents.zh: 结合多种方法的任务仍然明确规定了必须提交的内容以及检查器所确认的内容。

sents.en: This permits research workflows to vary while the evaluated output remains explicit.
sents.zh: 这允许研究工作流程各不相同，同时被评估的输出保持明确。

paragraphs.en: Statements, environments, scorers, instance sets, and references remain fixed within an evaluation version. Corrections and additional tasks receive new versions with dated explanations. Reports identify which results are affected and whether re-evaluation is necessary. Source corrections can update a reference value in a later release with provenance; a model improvement is retained as an outcome rather than silently changing the comparison used for that evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 语句、环境、评分器、实例集和引用在一个评估版本内保持固定。 修正和新增任务会获得带有注明日期说明的新版本。 报告会标明哪些结果受到影响，以及是否需要重新评估。 来源修正可以在后续版本中连同出处信息更新引用值；而模型改进则作为一种结果保留，而不是悄悄更改该评估所用的比较基准。

sents.en: Statements, environments, scorers, instance sets, and references remain fixed within an evaluation version.
sents.zh: 语句、环境、评分器、实例集和引用在一个评估版本内保持固定。

sents.en: Corrections and additional tasks receive new versions with dated explanations.
sents.zh: 修正和新增任务会获得带有注明日期说明的新版本。

sents.en: Reports identify which results are affected and whether re-evaluation is necessary.
sents.zh: 报告会标明哪些结果受到影响，以及是否需要重新评估。

sents.en: Source corrections can update a reference value in a later release with provenance; a model improvement is retained as an outcome rather than silently changing the comparison used for that evaluation.
sents.zh: 来源修正可以在后续版本中连同出处信息更新引用值；而模型改进则作为一种结果保留，而不是悄悄更改该评估所用的比较基准。

paragraphs.en: Retired tasks remain available with their historical version and retirement reason. Comparisons across releases report the common task set or explicitly identify the changed collection. A maintained benchmark can thereby grow without rewriting earlier results.
paragraphs.zh: 已退役的任务仍可使用，并保留其历史版本和退役原因。 跨版本的比较会报告共同的任务集，或明确指出发生变化的集合。 因此，一个持续维护的基准可以在不重写早期结果的情况下不断增长。

sents.en: Retired tasks remain available with their historical version and retirement reason.
sents.zh: 已退役的任务仍可使用，并保留其历史版本和退役原因。

sents.en: Comparisons across releases report the common task set or explicitly identify the changed collection.
sents.zh: 跨版本的比较会报告共同的任务集，或明确指出发生变化的集合。

sents.en: A maintained benchmark can thereby grow without rewriting earlier results.
sents.zh: 因此，一个持续维护的基准可以在不重写早期结果的情况下不断增长。

paragraphs.en: The project maintains an artifact index linking results to the statements or objects checked, their originating task versions, and verification records. Research status distinguishes reproduction, validated improvement relative to a specified reference, and a novelty claim supported by source review. Verified special cases and reductions can be indexed alongside the complete-resolution score, preserving their mathematical content without changing that score retrospectively.
paragraphs.zh: 该项目维护一个产物索引，将结果与被核查的命题或对象、其来源任务版本以及验证记录相关联。 研究状态区分复现、相对于指定参照的已验证改进，以及由文献综述支持的新颖性声明。 已验证的特殊情形和归约可与完整解决得分一同被索引，在保留其数学内容的同时不追溯性地更改该得分。

sents.en: The project maintains an artifact index linking results to the statements or objects checked, their originating task versions, and verification records.
sents.zh: 该项目维护一个产物索引，将结果与被核查的命题或对象、其来源任务版本以及验证记录相关联。

sents.en: Research status distinguishes reproduction, validated improvement relative to a specified reference, and a novelty claim supported by source review.
sents.zh: 研究状态区分复现、相对于指定参照的已验证改进，以及由文献综述支持的新颖性声明。

sents.en: Verified special cases and reductions can be indexed alongside the complete-resolution score, preserving their mathematical content without changing that score retrospectively.
sents.zh: 已验证的特殊情形和归约可与完整解决得分一同被索引，在保留其数学内容的同时不追溯性地更改该得分。

paragraphs.en: We selected five tasks per track, balancing subject coverage, difficulty, and evaluation cost. Using the original six agents’ results, we compared candidate subsets by how well they preserved pairwise agent orderings and approximated Full track scores, then reviewed their mathematical and computational content to finalize the list. Selected tasks retain their original scoring rules and receive equal weight within each track. The list was fixed before evaluating Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. The Index in Equation 1 is a later reporting summary, applied with the same weights to both suites.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个赛道中选取五个任务，兼顾学科覆盖面、难度和评测成本。 利用最初六个智能体的结果，我们根据候选子集在多大程度上保留了智能体两两之间的排序以及逼近完整赛道分数的程度来进行比较，然后审阅其数学与计算内容，最终确定清单。 被选中的任务保留其原始评分规则，并在每个赛道内获得相同权重。 该清单在评测 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 之前即已固定。 式 1 中的指数是后续汇报用的汇总指标，对两个套件采用相同的权重计算。

sents.en: We selected five tasks per track, balancing subject coverage, difficulty, and evaluation cost.
sents.zh: 我们在每个赛道中选取五个任务，兼顾学科覆盖面、难度和评测成本。

sents.en: Using the original six agents’ results, we compared candidate subsets by how well they preserved pairwise agent orderings and approximated Full track scores, then reviewed their mathematical and computational content to finalize the list.
sents.zh: 利用最初六个智能体的结果，我们根据候选子集在多大程度上保留了智能体两两之间的排序以及逼近完整赛道分数的程度来进行比较，然后审阅其数学与计算内容，最终确定清单。

sents.en: Selected tasks retain their original scoring rules and receive equal weight within each track.
sents.zh: 被选中的任务保留其原始评分规则，并在每个赛道内获得相同权重。

sents.en: The list was fixed before evaluating Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.
sents.zh: 该清单在评测 Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 之前即已固定。

sents.en: The Index in Equation 1 is a later reporting summary, applied with the same weights to both suites.
sents.zh: 式 1 中的指数是后续汇报用的汇总指标，对两个套件采用相同的权重计算。

paragraphs.en: The theorem subset includes both tasks solved by several agents and tasks with no accepted proof in the original cohort. Solver tasks span several types of input and certificate. Construction tasks cover discrete and geometric objects as well as an approximation bound. The open-conjecture subset gives coverage across five research directions. These choices retain variation within a five-task track while reducing the total number of task attempts by 80% relative to Full.
paragraphs.zh: 定理子集既包括由多个智能体解决的任务，也包括在原始队列中没有获得接受证明的任务。 求解任务涵盖多种类型的输入和证书。 构造任务涵盖离散对象和几何对象，以及一个近似界。 开放猜想子集覆盖五个研究方向。 这些选择在五任务赛道内保留了多样性，同时相对于 Full 将任务尝试总数减少了 80%。

sents.en: The theorem subset includes both tasks solved by several agents and tasks with no accepted proof in the original cohort.
sents.zh: 定理子集既包括由多个智能体解决的任务，也包括在原始队列中没有获得接受证明的任务。

sents.en: Solver tasks span several types of input and certificate.
sents.zh: 求解任务涵盖多种类型的输入和证书。

sents.en: Construction tasks cover discrete and geometric objects as well as an approximation bound.
sents.zh: 构造任务涵盖离散对象和几何对象，以及一个近似界。

sents.en: The open-conjecture subset gives coverage across five research directions.
sents.zh: 开放猜想子集覆盖五个研究方向。

sents.en: These choices retain variation within a five-task track while reducing the total number of task attempts by 80% relative to Full.
sents.zh: 这些选择在五任务赛道内保留了多样性，同时相对于 Full 将任务尝试总数减少了 80%。

paragraphs.en: Full contains 1,600 task attempts: 1,000 from the original six agents and 300 each from Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017. Lite contains 340 entries across nine agents. Of these, 240 are the 15 shared non-Solver tasks across the eight common agents, reusing the same submissions in both suite summaries. The remaining 100 entries comprise 80 separate Lite Solver attempts and the 20 Opus attempts.
paragraphs.zh: Full 包含 1,600 次任务尝试：其中 1,000 次来自最初的六个智能体，300 次来自 Kimi K3.1 Pro，300 次来自 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017。 Lite 包含跨九个智能体的 340 条条目。 其中，240 条是八个共同智能体共享的 15 个非 Solver 任务，在两份套件摘要中重复使用相同的提交结果。 其余 100 条条目包括 80 次独立的 Lite Solver 尝试和 20 次 Opus 尝试。

sents.en: Full contains 1,600 task attempts: 1,000 from the original six agents and 300 each from Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017.
sents.zh: Full 包含 1,600 次任务尝试：其中 1,000 次来自最初的六个智能体，300 次来自 Kimi K3.1 Pro，300 次来自 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017。

sents.en: Lite contains 340 entries across nine agents.
sents.zh: Lite 包含跨九个智能体的 340 条条目。

sents.en: Of these, 240 are the 15 shared non-Solver tasks across the eight common agents, reusing the same submissions in both suite summaries.
sents.zh: 其中，240 条是八个共同智能体共享的 15 个非 Solver 任务，在两份套件摘要中重复使用相同的提交结果。

sents.en: The remaining 100 entries comprise 80 separate Lite Solver attempts and the 20 Opus attempts.
sents.zh: 其余 100 条条目包括 80 次独立的 Lite Solver 尝试和 20 次 Opus 尝试。

paragraphs.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek 1017 each contribute three repetitions. For each agent, Full combines 45 shared non-Solver attempts with three repetitions on the remaining 85 tasks, including all 30 Online Solver problems. The 15 Offline Solver attempts contribute only to Lite. Every repetition contributes to the task means.
paragraphs.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek 1017 各贡献三次重复。 对每个智能体而言，Full 将 45 次共享的非 Solver 尝试与其余 85 个任务上的三次重复相结合，其中包括全部 30 道 Online Solver 题目。 这 15 次 Offline Solver 尝试仅计入 Lite。 每次重复都计入任务均值。

sents.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro and DeepSeek 1017 each contribute three repetitions.
sents.zh: Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 DeepSeek 1017 各贡献三次重复。

sents.en: For each agent, Full combines 45 shared non-Solver attempts with three repetitions on the remaining 85 tasks, including all 30 Online Solver problems.
sents.zh: 对每个智能体而言，Full 将 45 次共享的非 Solver 尝试与其余 85 个任务上的三次重复相结合，其中包括全部 30 道 Online Solver 题目。

sents.en: The 15 Offline Solver attempts contribute only to Lite.
sents.zh: 这 15 次 Offline Solver 尝试仅计入 Lite。

sents.en: Every repetition contributes to the task means.
sents.zh: 每次重复都计入任务均值。

paragraphs.en: Opus uses Claude Code 2.1.283 with the one-million-token context option and maximum reasoning effort. Table 9 gives the configurations of the other agents.
paragraphs.zh: Opus 使用 Claude Code 2.1.283，并启用一百万词元上下文选项和最大推理力度。 表 9 给出了其他智能体的配置。

sents.en: Opus uses Claude Code 2.1.283 with the one-million-token context option and maximum reasoning effort.
sents.zh: Opus 使用 Claude Code 2.1.283，并启用一百万词元上下文选项和最大推理力度。

sents.en: Table 9 gives the configurations of the other agents.
sents.zh: 表 9 给出了其他智能体的配置。

paragraphs.en: All shared non-Solver scores are equal between the two suite records. Solver comparison uses the same fixed Kimi K3 reference, the original task score definitions, and each suite’s recorded development protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 两个测试套件记录中，所有共享的非求解器评分均相同。 求解器对比使用同一个固定的 Kimi K3 参考基准、原始任务评分定义，以及各测试套件记录的开发协议。

sents.en: All shared non-Solver scores are equal between the two suite records.
sents.zh: 两个测试套件记录中，所有共享的非求解器评分均相同。

sents.zh: 求解器对比使用同一个固定的 Kimi K3 参考基准、原始任务评分定义，以及各测试套件记录的开发协议。

paragraphs.en: We compare the eight agents with both Full and Lite results. Spearman’s rank correlation is ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 , and 26 of the 28 unordered pairs have the same Index order. The two reversals are DeepSeek 1017 versus GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8 Max (0902): DeepSeek 1017 is fourth among the shared agents on Full and sixth on Lite. Astra, Kimi K3.1 Pro, and Kimi K3 retain the top three positions. Excluding DeepSeek 1017, the other seven agents retain their full pairwise order. The Lite task list was selected using the original six agents and fixed before either Kimi K3.1 Pro or DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 was evaluated. Opus is the ninth agent on the Lite leaderboard.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Full 和 Lite 两种结果下对这八个智能体进行比较。 Spearman 秩相关系数为 ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93，且 28 个无序对中有 26 个的 Index 排序一致。 两处反转是 DeepSeek 1017 与 GLM-5.3 之间，以及 Qwen3.8 Max (0902)：DeepSeek 1017 在共享智能体中于 Full 下排名第四，而在 Lite 下排名第六。 Astra、Kimi K3.1 Pro 和 Kimi K3 保持前三的位置。 除 DeepSeek 1017 外，其余七个智能体保持它们之间的全部两两排序。 Lite 任务列表是使用最初的六个智能体选定的，并在评估 Kimi K3.1 Pro 或 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 之前就已固定。 Opus 是 Lite 排行榜上的第九个智能体。

sents.en: We compare the eight agents with both Full and Lite results.
sents.zh: 我们在 Full 和 Lite 两种结果下对这八个智能体进行比较。

sents.en: Spearman’s rank correlation is ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93 , and 26 of the 28 unordered pairs have the same Index order.
sents.zh: Spearman 秩相关系数为 ρ = 0.93 \rho=0.93，且 28 个无序对中有 26 个的 Index 排序一致。

sents.en: The two reversals are DeepSeek 1017 versus GLM-5.3 and Qwen3.8 Max (0902): DeepSeek 1017 is fourth among the shared agents on Full and sixth on Lite.
sents.zh: 两处反转是 DeepSeek 1017 与 GLM-5.3 之间，以及 Qwen3.8 Max (0902)：DeepSeek 1017 在共享智能体中于 Full 下排名第四，而在 Lite 下排名第六。

sents.en: Opus is the ninth agent on the Lite leaderboard.
sents.zh: Opus 是 Lite 排行榜上的第九个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Theorem rankings reverse DeepSeek 1017 against GLM-5.3, Qwen3.8 Max (0902), and Grok 4.6. Solver reverses six pairs: Kimi K3.1 Pro versus Qwen3.8 Max (0902), DeepSeek 1017, and DeepSeek 0910; Kimi K3 versus GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek 0910; and GLM-5.3 versus DeepSeek 0910. Construction reverses Kimi K3.1 Pro versus GLM-5.3, and Kimi K3 versus Qwen3.8 Max (0902) and DeepSeek 1017. All Lite open-conjecture scores are zero, whereas Full has accepted refutations on two tasks outside the subset. These results quantify the aggregate agreement and the capability-specific differences under the two suite protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 定理排名使 DeepSeek 1017 相对 GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 和 Grok 4.6 的排名发生逆转。 求解器使六对模型发生逆转：Kimi K3.1 Pro 相对 Qwen3.8 Max (0902)、DeepSeek 1017 和 DeepSeek 0910；Kimi K3 相对 GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek 0910；以及 GLM-5.3 相对 DeepSeek 0910。 构造使 Kimi K3.1 Pro 相对 GLM-5.3，以及 Kimi K3 相对 Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 和 DeepSeek 1017 发生逆转。 Lite 的所有开放猜想得分均为零，而 Full 在子集之外的两个任务上有已接受的反驳。 这些结果量化了两种套件协议下的总体一致性以及特定能力上的差异。

sents.zh: 定理排名使 DeepSeek 1017 相对 GLM-5.3、Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 和 Grok 4.6 的排名发生逆转。

sents.en: Solver reverses six pairs: Kimi K3.1 Pro versus Qwen3.8 Max (0902), DeepSeek 1017, and DeepSeek 0910; Kimi K3 versus GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek 0910; and GLM-5.3 versus DeepSeek 0910.
sents.zh: 求解器使六对模型发生逆转：Kimi K3.1 Pro 相对 Qwen3.8 Max (0902)、DeepSeek 1017 和 DeepSeek 0910；Kimi K3 相对 GLM-5.3 和 DeepSeek 0910；以及 GLM-5.3 相对 DeepSeek 0910。

sents.en: Construction reverses Kimi K3.1 Pro versus GLM-5.3, and Kimi K3 versus Qwen3.8 Max (0902) and DeepSeek 1017.
sents.zh: 构造使 Kimi K3.1 Pro 相对 GLM-5.3，以及 Kimi K3 相对 Qwen3.8 Max (0902) 和 DeepSeek 1017 发生逆转。

sents.en: All Lite open-conjecture scores are zero, whereas Full has accepted refutations on two tasks outside the subset.
sents.zh: Lite 的所有开放猜想得分均为零，而 Full 在子集之外的两个任务上有已接受的反驳。

sents.en: These results quantify the aggregate agreement and the capability-specific differences under the two suite protocols.
sents.zh: 这些结果量化了两种套件协议下的总体一致性以及特定能力上的差异。
